title: SEO Manager (m/w/d) in Teilzeit
description:
Über GetMentioned

GetMentioned.com ist die SEO-Plattform für Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Agenturen, Inhouse-SEOs und Marketing-Teams erreichen mit uns Top-Rankings für ihre wichtigsten Suchbegriffe und werden in ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co. genannt. Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern. 

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das SEO und die KI-Sichtbarkeit von getmentioned.com. Du entscheidest, welche Themen wir besetzen, welche Seiten wir bauen oder verbessern und was als Nächstes passiert. Daneben betreuen wir noch einige wenige SEO-Kunden, denen du bei Fragen und in der strategischen Beratung zur Seite stehst; der Aufwand dafür hält sich in Grenzen.

Dein Impact

Wir verkaufen Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Jede Seite, die du nach vorn bringst, bringt Besucher und Anfragen. Und wenn ChatGPT nach dem besten Anbieter für Linkaufbau gefragt wird, soll die Antwort GetMentioned lauten.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du legst fest, welche Suchbegriffe und Fragen wir besetzen, in Google und in KI-Suchen.

- Du planst die Themen, schreibst Briefings und eigene Texte und überarbeitest bestehende Seiten, mit unserer Content Engine TextRocket und KI. Wo es sinnvoll ist, steuerst du Freelancer.

- Du kümmerst dich um Onpage und Technik: interne Verlinkung, Seitenstruktur, Meta-Daten, strukturierte Daten, Indexierung und Ladezeit, gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und die AI Overviews GetMentioned nennen, wenn es um Backlinks, Brand Mentions und Digital PR geht.

- Du planst Links, Erwähnungen und Digital PR für die eigene Marke über unseren Marktplatz.

- Du beobachtest Search Console, Rankings und KI-Erwähnungen und weißt jede Woche, was sich bewegt hat und warum.

- Du beantwortest Fragen unserer wenigen SEO-Kunden und gibst ihnen strategische Empfehlungen.

- Du bringst deine SEO-Praxis in die Plattform ein. Du testest neue Funktionen und sagst dem Produktteam, was Kunden wirklich brauchen.

- Du verantwortest das SEO von GetMentioned.com gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung.

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

- Das eigene SEO hat einen festen Takt: Mindestens 5-10 neue oder überarbeitete Inhalte pro Woche.

- Getmentioned.com wächst in Google: Die organischen Klicks laut Search Console steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

- GetMentioned wird in KI-Suchen genannt: Wir prüfen jeden Monat ein festes Set an Fragen in ChatGPT, Perplexity und den AI Overviews. GetMentioned wird bei immer mehr davon genannt.

- Aus Besuchern werden Kunden: Die Registrierungen aus der organischen Suche steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

- Kunden bekommen schnell eine Antwort: Fachliche Kundenfragen sind innerhalb eines Werktags beantwortet und landen nicht mehr beim Geschäftsführer.

Was du allein entscheidest

- Welche Themen und Seiten als Nächstes kommen und wer sie schreibt.

- Was auf getmentioned.com veröffentlicht und überarbeitet wird, innerhalb unserer Markenregeln.

- Freelancer beauftragst du ohne Rückfrage, innerhalb eines Monatsbudgets, das wir gemeinsam festlegen.

- Welche SEO-Empfehlung du unseren Kunden gibst.

- In welcher Reihenfolge du deine Arbeit angehst, solange alle Termine halten.

Unsere Werte

Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt.

- Ergebnisse. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt. Wann und wo du arbeitest, entscheidest du, solange du erreichbar bist. Bewerbungen mit Track-Records sehen wir gern.

- Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche.

- Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um.

- Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder als Prozess mit unserem Dev Team oder KI.

Wen wir suchen

- Mindestens 2 Jahre SEO in der Praxis, in einer Agentur oder Inhouse.

- Du hast schon eine Website selbst nach vorn gebracht und kannst die Zahlen dazu zeigen.

- Sicherer Umgang mit der Search Console, mit Sistrix oder Ahrefs und mit einem Content-Tool wie Surfer.

- Du schreibst gute Texte selbst mit KI und erkennst, wann ein KI-Text noch nicht gut genug ist.

- Du priorisierst selbst. Aus zwanzig offenen Themen ziehst du das eine, das jetzt zählt.

- Du denkst selbst. Bei einem Problem, das du noch nie gesehen hast, stellst du die richtigen Fragen, bevor du loslegst.

- Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser und diskutierst es nicht weg.

- Du nutzt KI jeden Tag und hast Erfahrung in Claude Code / Codex und evtl. auch bereits eigene SEO Tools gebaut

- Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Gutes Englisch und Wort und Schrift.

Erfahrung mit KI-Sichtbarkeit, im Linkaufbau oder mit B2B- und SaaS-Websites ist ein Vorteil.
Track-Record bei eigenen Projekten und Kundenprojekten ist ebenfalls ein Vorteil.

Ehrlich kommuniziert vorab

- Die 25 Stunden verteilst du auf alle fünf Werktage, zum Beispiel vormittags. So bist du für das Team und unsere Kunden jeden Tag erreichbar.

- Wer lieber zuarbeitet oder SEO als Checkliste abarbeitet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.

Was wir bieten

- 25.000 bis 32.000 € brutto im Jahr bei 25 Stunden pro Woche, je nach Erfahrung. Das entspricht 40.000 bis 51.200 € auf Vollzeitbasis.

- 25 Stunden pro Woche, remote.

- Eine eigene SEO-Plattform mit Marktplatz, Content Engine und Daten, die du für unsere eigene Marke voll nutzen kannst.

- Zugang zu Sistrix, Ahrefs und Surfer sowie KI-Tools und eigenen SEO Abläufen, mit denen wir arbeiten.

- Direkter Draht zum Geschäftsführer mit mehr als 10 Jahren SEO Erfahrung. Enorme Entwicklungs-Möglichkeit, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich. 

- Dein nächster Schritt: Wächst die Arbeit, kannst du mehr Stunden übernehmen und die Leitung SEO und AI Search mit eigenem Team aufbauen - auch international.

So läuft die Bewerbung

- Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf inkl. Website, die du nach vorn gebracht hast, mit den Zahlen dazu. Beantworte in deiner Bewerbung in genau drei Sätzen: Warum willst du genau diese Stelle? Wie genau du diese Anleitung befolgst, ist schon Teil der Auswahl.

- Gespräch per Video mit all unseren und Deinen Fragen.

- 2 Arbeitsproben & Live-Arbeit. Details folgen in der jeweiligen Runde.

title: Senior Associate, Internal Communications, International
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

About the Company

DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt are one global team building the future of local commerce. Our products power millions of interactions between consumers, merchants, and couriers every day, in cities around the world. Together, we're combining global scale with deep local understanding to deliver what's next. In this role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across all three brands.

About the Team

This role sits within the Global Internal Communications team, a high-impact group focused on engaging and connecting with DoordDash, Deliveroo and Wolt's most important audience: our employees. This role will specifically support the International business (Deliveroo and Wolt) in Europe and the Middle East (EMEA).

We are responsible for leading employee communications centred around our company-wide strategy, business goals, and financial results to ensure employees understand the company's near- and long-term vision. This team works cross-functionally with key business stakeholders, touching every corner of the organisation.

About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, International Internal Communications, you will provide support across the Deliveroo and Wolt businesses including being the key internal comms point of contact for our EMEA country teams, working on change and issues communications, and partnering on content creation and relevant internationally focused projects. 

This role is ideal for someone with between 5-10 years of communications experience who is experienced in working with multiple stakeholders in fast paced but sometimes ambiguous environments. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager to translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees.

Day to day you'll be:

- 
Acting as the main internal comms point of contact for Deliveroo and Wolt (EMEA) country teams and regional communications managers

- 
Building and maintaining the community of internal communicators across the EMEA footprint, sharing best practice and editorial guidance and keeping consistency with international IC standards.

- 
Supporting crisis and issues communications across EMEA, partnering with the Senior Director and Senior Managers 

- 
Providing change management comms support, partnering with the change management comms lead and people team on delivery.

- 
Creating content to support company level events, such as all hands

- 
Leading on analytics and measurement for such events for the international internal comms team, working closely with the digital channels team.

- 
Operating effectively as part of a global team partnering with the international business.

We're excited about you because…

- 
You have a strong (5yrs +) track record of communications experience.

- 
You work well with multiple stakeholders across countries and brands, and can build and sustain a network of communicators.

- 
You thrive in fast paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, and stay effective when situations move quickly.

- 
You can translate complex or evolving information into clear, effective communications for employees.

- 
You are comfortable supporting crisis, issues and change communications.

- 
You are comfortable with data, and can turn engagement reporting into insights.

- 
You are flexible and can turn your hand to a wide range of comms projects and topics 

Next steps

- 
Step 1: Apply before Mon 26th October

- 
Step 2: Screening with our recruitment team

- 
Step 3: Panel interview with hiring manager and team lead

- 
Step 4: Written test and final interview

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

- Erste Erfahrung im Software Testing, idealerweise im manuellen Testen

- Erfahrung mit GitLab

- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis

- Erfahrung im explorativen Testen

- Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the Company: 

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine , highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive . The New York Times , Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100 . Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

About the team 

The AI & Biometrics team at Tools for Humanity owns the machine learning systems behind the World Network. Our iris and face recognition systems, our anti-spoofing pipeline, and the models running on the Orb and on phones are what make Proof of Personhood actually work at scale.

Within the Face team, we develop systems for face verification, uniqueness and duplicate detection, presentation attack detection, and supporting capabilities such as face detection, image quality assessment, occlusion detection, pose estimation, and others that allow these systems to operate reliably in real-world conditions.

Our work spans the full machine learning lifecycle: defining data-collection and labeling requirements, curating datasets, conducting applied computer-vision research, training and evaluating models, adversarial testing, supporting deployment, investigating production behavior, and monitoring performance after release.

The problems we work on are grounded in real-world conditions. Our systems must handle variation in cameras, lighting, pose, image quality, occlusion, user behavior, and attack methods. They must also operate within strict latency and memory budgets and interact with privacy-preserving systems (Anonymized Multi-Party Computation) that compare users against a growing identity set. At our scale, small regressions can have a meaningful impact, so evaluation, operating-point selection, and production monitoring are central to how we work.

We are pragmatic about our methods. We use deep learning where it provides clear value, classical computer vision and image processing where they are more efficient or reliable, and hybrid approaches when they produce the best system.

The team is well supported. We have a dedicated Mobile subteam that owns deployment to mobile devices, ML Infrastructure and MLOps subteams that own the data pipelines, training clusters, GPU fleet, and much of the underlying tooling, and Face and Iris subteams dedicated to each modality. Face engineers own problem formulation, data requirements, data-quality decisions, model behavior, evaluation methodology, and investigation of model failures for their projects to succeed. We also work closely with the Orb software, Mobile, Proof of Personhood, and Product teams to take ideas to production.

In this role, you will: 

- Own face machine learning projects from initial problem definition through data preparation, experimentation, evaluation, production validation, and monitoring, while partnering with different teams.

- Improve our core biometric identification and anti-spoofing models, training and iterating on deep learning architectures, losses, and data pipelines, with model size, latency, and memory budgets as first-class design constraints from day one.

- Use classical computer vision and image processing when they are the right solution, whether as a complete method, a preprocessing stage, a lightweight on-device component, or a diagnostic tool. We are not a deep learning only team, and on-device compute rewards the discipline of using the lighter solution when it fits.

- Lead independent applied ML initiatives end-to-end : form a written hypothesis, design ablations that isolate variables, run experiments, read results honestly, and know when to ship and when to stop chasing the last percentage point

- Work directly with face images and datasets : improve collection and labels, inspect difficult samples, identify failure modes, and use those findings to drive model and evaluation changes.

- Build evaluation pipelines that catch model regressions before they reach production, monitoring that can reveal data drift, score-distribution changes, new attack patterns, cohort-specific regressions, or unexpected model behavior, and improve internal tools for data analysis, model training, evaluation, visualization, red teaming, and monitoring.

- Read and evaluate relevant computer vision and biometrics research , adapting useful ideas to our systems without treating paper reproduction as the objective.

- Write design documents, experiment reports, post-launch analysis and technical proposals that remain useful after the project is complete, and others can understand and build on your work.

- Help shape technical standards across the AI & Biometrics team: evaluation methodology, experimentation discipline, model versioning, monitoring, and across any engineering and scientific standards of the team.

You may be a strong fit if you have: 

- Significant hands-on experience training, evaluating, and shipping deep learning systems for computer vision , with practical understanding of latency and memory constraints.

- Experience taking an ambiguous machine learning problem and turning it into a structured technical plan.

- Strong practical knowledge of model training, including data pipelines, augmentations, architecture selection, loss functions, optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and failure analysis.

- Strong foundations in classical computer vision and image processing , with experience including tools such as OpenCV, NumPy, or equivalent libraries. Fluency in Python and a modern deep-learning framework such as PyTorch.

- Experience designing evaluations that support real production decisions, including metric selection, operating thresholds, calibration, dataset construction, slicing, leakage prevention, and regression analysis.

- The ability to write maintainable research and production-quality code.

- A pragmatic, applied-research mindset : rigorous about experiments, but able to determine when a result is ready to ship and when further optimization has diminishing value.

- Strong written communication. You define the problem, requirements, assumptions, experiments, success criteria, and conclusions clearly.

- A collaborative operating style : you work independently without becoming isolated, and you actively share context and knowledge with others, engaging constructively with constraints from neighboring teams rather than treating them as obstacles. We are not looking for a lone wolf, however brilliant.

- An " in-the-driver's-seat " operating style: you take ownership of problems end-to-end, drive your work forward without waiting for direction, and stand behind your decisions once they are in production.

- Additional Nice-to-haves :

- Direct experience with biometric verification/identification; margin-based metric learning losses and their failure modes; presentation attack and liveness detection; or adversarial evaluation of ML systems.

- Experience with edge optimization and on-device deployment of ML models. Quantization, pruning, distillation, kernel-level optimization, deployment to mobile NPUs, embedded GPUs, microcontrollers, or other constrained targets.

- Hands-on experience with Rust for high-performance code paths, and the disposition to optimize for speed rather than treat it as someone else's problem.

- A background in sensors, imaging, computational photography, or camera ISPs.

- Familiarity with privacy-preserving computation or machine learning systems that interact with secure multi-party computation.

- Data. Define the data we need to measure and improve our models.

- Model releases. Co-lead new model releases. You own the quality go/no-go and the capability claims.

- Comfort in an ambiguous, fast-changing research environment, where the right priority shifts as the model and harness evolve.

title: Expert Financial Performance & Value Creation (m/w/d)
description:
Die Chance

Steuerberatungen rechnen rückwärts. Sie wissen genau, was im letzten Jahr passiert ist, und erstaunlich wenig darüber, welches Mandat, welche Leistung und welcher Mitarbeiter morgen Geld verdient.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen aus dem Bestand und durch Übernahmen. Beides stellt dieselbe Frage in zwei Formen: Was verdienen unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams tatsächlich, und was folgt daraus für die nächsten zwölf Monate.

Die Rolle ist auf ein bis drei Jahre Beratungserfahrung zugeschnitten. Du treibst die finanzielle Steuerung von der Ertragsseite her. Du siehst auf die Zahlen, erkennst, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, und gehst damit zu den Menschen, die es ändern können, auch wenn das Gespräch unangenehm wird. So lange, bis die Wirkung in den Zahlen steht. Du berichtest an Moritz Bonacker.

Was du verantwortest

Ertragskraft und Produktivität

- Durchleuchte die Bestände auf den echten Daten des laufenden Rechnungswesens, von der Mandatsgröße bis zum Deckungsbeitrag, und mach sichtbar, was heute stillschweigend miterbracht und nicht abgerechnet wird.

- Bewerte die Produktivität auf beiden Seiten: je Leistungsart, welche ihren Deckungsbeitrag trägt und welche quersubventioniert wird, und je Mitarbeiter, wo Wertschöpfung je eingesetzter Stunde entsteht.

- Dein Maßstab: keine Analyse ohne benannte Maßnahme, benannten Verantwortlichen und benanntes Datum.

Durchsetzung

- Führ die Honorargespräche selbst oder mit einem Berufsträger an deiner Seite. Und sprich auch die unangenehmen Fälle aus: Nicht jedes Mandat hat einen Weg in die Profitabilität.

- Geh mit deinen Zahlen direkt zu den fachlich Verantwortlichen: was ihre Mandate und Teams produzieren, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, was sich konkret ändern muss.

- Verfolge die Maßnahmen nach, bis das Ergebnis in den Zahlen steht. Auch wenn es unbequem wird.

Zukauf und Vorausschau

- Entwickle je Übernahme den Wertsteigerungsplan auf der finanziellen Seite und verfolge ihn über Jahre statt über hundert Tage. Dein Maßstab: Die dritte Übernahme läuft besser als die erste, weil du beide gemacht hast.

- Verantworte Umsatz- und Ergebnisprognose, Budgets, Szenarien und Abweichungsanalysen über alle Standorte, auch die neu dazugekommenen.

- Automatisiere, was du baust. Keine Auswertung, die jemand monatlich manuell zusammensetzt.

Fragen, auf die du die Antwort findest

- Ein Mandat trägt seinen Deckungsbeitrag nicht, die Beziehung besteht seit fünfzehn Jahren: Wie gehst du in dieses Gespräch, und wo ist deine Grenze?

- Woran unterscheidest du eine Leistung, die zu billig ist, von einer, die zu aufwendig erbracht wird?

- Deine Empfehlung wird von jemandem blockiert, der dir nicht berichtet. Was tust du, wenn das zweite Gespräch auch nichts bringt?

Woran wir Erfolg messen

- Nach 6 Monaten: Der erste Bestand ist vollständig durchgerechnet, Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat und Leistungsart liegen belastbar vor, die erste Auswertung läuft automatisiert, die ersten Honorargespräche hast du selbst geführt.

- Nach 12 Monaten: Die erste Anpassungswelle ist über den Bestand gefahren, das erreichte Honorarniveau nachgewiesen. Die Deckungsbeitragsrechnung wird in Führungsentscheidungen verwendet. Deine Prognose trägt, ihre Abweichung kannst du erklären.

- Nach 24 Monaten: Mehrere Übernahmen begleitet, die spätere lief nachweislich besser als die erste. Die Steuerung läuft weitgehend automatisiert, dein Anteil hat sich von der Aufbereitung zur Interpretation verschoben.

- Wohin es führt: in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn, mit größerem Themenfeld und mehr methodischer Autorität. Willst du ein Team aufbauen, steht dir die Führungslaufbahn ebenso offen. Entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

Was du mitbringst

- Du hast ein bis drei Jahre in der Beratung gearbeitet, in der Strategieberatung, in Transaction Services oder in einem Wertsteigerungs-Team: kommerzielle Prüfung, Pricing, Ergebnisverbesserung.

- Du hast Profitabilität auf Kunden-, Produkt- oder Leistungsebene gerechnet und die Ergebnisse gegenüber Entscheidern vertreten, nicht nur aufbereitet.

- Du führst unangenehme Gespräche, statt sie aufzuschieben, ob es um Geld oder um Leistung geht, und hältst deine Position, wenn Widerspruch kommt.

- Du beherrschst Excel jenseits von Pivot-Tabellen und liest eine Buchführung, ohne Steuerberater zu sein. SQL oder Python sind kein Zusatz, sondern der Weg, dieselbe Auswertung nicht zweimal von Hand zu bauen.

- Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Datenanalyse, Mustererkennung in Bestandsdaten und Drafting.

- Du bewegst Menschen ohne Weisungsbefugnis, über eine Rechnung, die niemand bestreiten kann, und über einen Ton, der Widerstand nicht erzeugt. Und du setzt in allem den höchsten Standard, weil Mittelmaß für dich keine Option ist.

Ein Plus, keine Bedingung

- Erfahrung aus einem Wertsteigerungsprogramm nach einer Übernahme. Dass du es nie selbst zu Ende umgesetzt hast, ist kein Ausschluss, genau das ist hier die Aufgabe.

- Nähe zur Steuerberatung oder zu einer anderen Dienstleistung, die in Stunden verkauft wird.

- Kein kanonischer Lebenslauf nötig: Steuerberater mit ausgeprägter Zahlen- und Preisneigung, Bank- oder Beteiligungsprofil mit Wunsch nach einer operativen Rolle, Praxismanager, der eine Einheit nachweislich auf Deckungsbeitrag umgestellt hat. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: Das obere Ende steht für den Umfang des verantworteten Themenfelds und für die Fähigkeit, Menschen ohne Weisungsbefugnis zu bewegen. Ein anderer Hintergrund startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau.

Was diese Rolle ist, und was nicht

- Rechnen und sprechen, nicht abgeben. Du gibst das Ergebnis nicht ab, du führst das Gespräch darüber. Wäre das eine Excel-Rolle, wäre sie falsch geschnitten.

- Entscheidungen tragen, nicht dokumentieren. Jede Zahl, die du baust, muss eine Entscheidung tragen. Monatsabschluss-Kommentierung ohne Konsequenz gibt es hier nicht.

- Überzeugen, nicht anweisen. Die Berufsträger und Teams, mit denen du arbeitest, berichten nicht an dich. Wer Widerstand über Hierarchie löst, kommt hier nicht weit.

Warum Vogel

- Die Frage ist im Markt ungelöst. Kaum ein Haus dieser Branche kennt seinen Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat. Du baust die Antwort.

- Du siehst, was aus deiner Empfehlung wird. Hier begleitest du dieselben Mandate über Jahre, statt nach der Abgabe zu gehen.

- Du willst entscheiden: Methode, Kennzahlen und Reihenfolge. Kein Gremium überstimmt dich. Vogel ist hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation, autonom in der Ausführung. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt.

- Substanz im Rücken. Ein profitables, wachsendes Unternehmen mit etablierten Mandanten. Was du verbesserst, wirkt auf eine Basis, die bereits trägt.

FAQ 

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? 

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? 

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

title: Director Tax (m/w/d)

Die Steuerberatung ordnet sich neu. Tausende Kanzleien suchen eine Nachfolge, und die meisten Käufer addieren Umsatz, ohne den Bereich darunter zu entwickeln. Wer hier einen Praxis-Bereich baut, baut ihn in einem Markt, der gerade beweglich ist.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Steuerberatung ist dabei kein Geschäftsfeld unter vielen, sondern der Kern.

Was du verantwortest

Bereich und Wachstum

- Treib das Wachstum über eigene Akquise, die Zusammenarbeit über alle Vogel-Bereiche und die fachliche Anbindung übernommener Mandatsstämme.

Führung der Linie

- Führ eine eigene Führungslinie über mehrere Teams, drei bis fünf Menschen auf Bereichs-Niveau, mit tiefer indirekter Verantwortung für die Portfolios darunter.

Was du mitbringst

Wenn du Freude an strukturierter, teils monotoner Arbeit mit hohem Durchsatz hast, wirst du diese Rolle lieben. Wenn du nur brainstormen willst ist das hier nichts für dich.

Deine Aufgaben

- Buchungen und Kampagnenaufträge unserer Kunden im System aufnehmen, prüfen und sauber abwickeln

- Passende Publisher für Kundenprojekte auswählen, anfragen und Konditionen innerhalb der Vorgaben klären

- Laufende Kommunikation mit Kunden und Publishern (E‑Mail, Plattform, Calls)

- Lektorat von SEO Texten auf Deutsch & Englisch

- Bestehende Publisher-Beziehungen pflegen und neue relevante Quellen identifizieren

- Datenpflege & Auswertungen in unseren Tools (z. B. Eigene Plattform, CRM, SEO‑Tools)

- Prozesse mitdenken: Engpässe erkennen, Verbesserungsvorschläge machen und mit uns umsetzen

Was du mitbringst 

- 1–2+ Jahre Erfahrung in Offpage‑SEO / Linkbuilding / Digital PR oder Publisher‑Management

- Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort UND Schrift

- Gutes Englisch; Französisch ist ein Plus

- Erfahrung mit mind. einem SEO‑Tool (z. B. Ahrefs, Sistrix, Semrush o. Ä.)

- Du hast kein Problem damit, täglich viele Vorgänge diszipliniert abzuarbeiten

- Du nutzt KI jeden Tag. Mit ChatGPT, Claude oder ähnlichen Werkzeugen machst du Mails, Texte und Auswertungen schneller, und du prüfst, was sie liefern.

- Du meldest Probleme, bevor jemand fragt, und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen.

- Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser.

- Du bezeichnest dich selbst als zuverlässig, schnell, hungrig, entwicklungsbereit

Was wir dir bieten

- Klare Verantwortlichkeit für einen Kernbereich unseres Geschäfts (Fulfillment, Offpage & Publisher)

- Klare Ziele statt Micromanagement: du bekommst KPIs und den Rahmen, den Rest regelst du

- Entwicklungsoptionen Richtung Lead Offpage SEO / Teamlead Publisher Management

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit fester Erreichbarkeit, Remote‑Option, 40h/Woche

- Faires, transparentes Gehaltspaket mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeit (Range: 35.000 € - 45.000 € brutto jährlich, je nach Erfahrung)

Unsere Werte

Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt.

- Ergebnisse zählen. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt.

- Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche.

- Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um.

- Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder gemeinsam mit unserer DEV-Abteilung als Prozess.

So bewirbst du dich

Nutzen Sie den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns Ihre Unterlagen zu senden.

Danach geht es so weiter: 

- Runde 1: Gespräch per Video, 15 Minuten. Wir stellen Rolle, Ziele und Werte vor und stellen/beantworten alle Fragen.

- Runde 2: Arbeitsprobe. Du bekommst ein echtes Kundenprojekt und eine Liste von Domains. Du wählst die passenden Publisher aus, begründest die Auswahl und baust daraus einen kleinen Plan. Ebenfalls stellen wir Dir 2 weitere Test-Aufgaben zur Verfügung.

- Runde 3: Live-Übung per Video, 30 Minuten. Wir spielen einen Publisher, der eine Frist gerissen hat, und einen verärgerten Kunden. Danach sagen wir dir direkt, was nicht funktioniert hat, und du machst es noch einmal.

title: Tech Lead AI DevOps / Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description:
Jobbeschreibung 

StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Seit Anfang 2026 sind wir Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn und der größten AI-Upskilling-Plattform des Kontinents. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen.

Gerade jetzt stehen wir an einem spannenden Punkt: Als Scale-up migrieren und konsolidieren wir unsere Infrastruktur von einzelnen Systemen auf einen skalierbaren Cloud-Stack, bei laufendem Betrieb, ohne Abstriche bei Uptime und Performance. Dafür suchen wir einen Tech Lead AI DevOps / Infrastructure (w/m/d) , der unsere Infrastruktur ganzheitlich verantwortet: Du baust sie auf, skalierst sie und schaffst damit die Grundlage, auf der unser Team wachsen kann. Das machst du mit einem kleinen DevOps-Team, das du führst. Langfristig sorgst du mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere Engineering-Teams im Rahmen eines Agentic SDLC ihre Produkte effizient auf sicherer und skalierbarer Infrastruktur shippen können.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du arbeitest als DevOps Tech Lead, das heißt du bist aktiver Contributor (Player & Coach) mit Führungsverantwortung für ein kleines Team und berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Engineering

- Du verantwortest die Skalierung, Wartung und Sicherung unserer gesamten Cloud-Infrastruktur, von der laufenden Migration bis zum stabilen Tagesbetrieb, und legst damit das Fundament, auf dem Team und Produkt wachsen können

- Du baust saubere Prozesse für Monitoring, Uptime, Backups und Recovery, Access Management, Security-Updates und Kostenkontrolle auf, wo heute noch vieles gewachsen und unstrukturiert ist

- Du setzt AI gezielt im DevOps-Alltag ein, von Incident-Analyse über Infrastruktur-Code bis hin zu Runbooks, und automatisierst wiederkehrende Betriebsaufgaben konsequent, damit ein kleines Team maximale Wirkung erzielt

- Du stellst sicher, dass interne und externe Entwicklung zuverlässig von DevOps unterstützt wird

- Du bereitest die Weiterentwicklung des Teams hin zu Platform Engineering für unseren Standort Berlin vor.

Was du mitbringst 

- 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in DevOps, SRE oder Platform Engineering, davon erste Lead-Verantwortung (Architektur, technische Entscheidungen, Mentoring)

- Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestütztem DevOps, also dem Einsatz von AI zur Automatisierung und Sicherung von Betrieb und Infrastruktur

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Infrastructure as Code und Container-Orchestrierung, z. B. mit Terraform, Kubernetes und Ansible

- Erfahrung im Betrieb eines Enterprise-Stacks mit vielen Komponenten (Data Warehouses, Applikationen, Datenbanken, Logging, Security Audits, Berechtigungssysteme) und ein sicheres Gefühl für Security, Backups und Recovery.

- Disziplin bei CI/CD, Monitoring und Observability (z. B. GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus o. ä.)

- Erfahrung darin, in schnell wachsenden Umgebungen zu agieren und für Struktur und Skalierung zu sorgen

- Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau

Passt eher nicht zu dir, wenn … 

Diese Rolle ist wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn du lieber führst, als selbst Hand anzulegen. Mit einem kleinen Team bist du Tech Lead und Engineer zugleich und bleibst selbst tief im System, im Design und im Code. Sie passt auch nicht gut, wenn du eine aufgeräumte Umgebung mit fertigen Prozessen erwartest: Vieles bei uns ist gewachsen, und genau dort Struktur zu schaffen, ist ein Kern deiner Aufgabe. Und wenn du AI-Tools eher als nettes Produktivitäts-Extra siehst und nicht als etwas, das die Arbeitsweise eines ganzen Teams grundlegend verändert, wirst du hier eher nicht glücklich.

Das bieten wir Dir 

Arbeitskultur 

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership 

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten 

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation 

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

As a Working Student / Intern GTM AI Growth Engineering , you build and launch AI-powered growth experiments that create new qualified demand for plancraft across Europe. - Scale successful experiments internationally – adapt winning tools and campaigns for international markets like Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands.

- You’re currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program (at least two semesters completed), ideally in Industrial Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical or business-technical field.

- You understand the fundamentals of digital acquisition funnels and can connect an experiment hypothesis to a measurable outcome.

- You take ownership from idea to execution, learn new tools independently, and prioritize shipping and learning over unnecessary perfection.

- You communicate clearly, document your work concisely, and are comfortable sharing results openly – including experiments that didn't succeed.

- You have fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

- You're available for 16–20 hours per week during the semester and remain enrolled at university throughout your working student contract. For an internship, you can commit to at least four months, ideally six months .

- Familiarity with HubSpot, Webflow, Figma, Linear, GitHub, Asana, or Claude Code.

- Experience launching a project with real users – whether through a startup, university initiative, personal project, or public launch.

- Interest in tradespeople, small businesses, and understanding how digital tools can improve their daily work.

- German skills at C1 level or additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHY PLANCRAFT? 

- Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary 

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do 

- Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.

- Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

- Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.

- Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications 

- Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.

- Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.

- An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.

- Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive .

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values 

- Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

- Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.

- Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.

- Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

- Own it and get it done. Results matter!

- Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.

- Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

About the Role 

We’re hiring a Risk Operations Analyst to sit within our first line fraud and risk function, reporting to the Fraud & Risk Manager. This role is the operational backbone of how Ryft manages its relationships with acquiring and banking partners, taking inbound queries from our acquires and bank partners and owning them through to resolution.

The core of this role is investigative. When a query comes in from a banking partner, we need someone who can trace a transaction end-to-end through our systems, understand what the bank is actually asking, produce a response that meets their expectations, and critically, question what they find along the way rather than closing the thread at the first plausible answer.

Alongside partner queries, you’ll carry out merchant risk monitoring as part of the broader fraud and risk operation; reviewing merchant behaviour, flagging anomalies, and feeding intelligence into the fraud detection and response process led by the Fraud & Risk Manager. If you’re someone who digs until they have the full picture, is comfortable navigating between internal systems and external expectations, and takes pride in the quality of what they send to a bank, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do 

Acquirer & Banking Partner Query Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for inbound risk and compliance queries from Ryft’s

acquiring and banking partners — managing each query through to full resolution.

• Trace transactions end-to-end through Ryft’s systems in response to partner queries —

reconstructing the payment journey, identifying where issues occurred, and producing clear, accurate responses that meet the bank’s expectations.

• Understand what each banking partner needs to see in a response and tailor your output

accordingly — whether that’s a transaction trail, a merchant explanation, supporting documentation, or a combination.

• Question what you find — don’t close a query at the first plausible answer. If something looks unusual or doesn’t add up, dig further and escalate to the Fraud & Risk Manager where needed.

• Maintain a clear log of all partner queries, response timelines, and outcomes, ensuring

nothing falls through the cracks and that patterns across queries are surfaced proactively.

• Build a working knowledge of each partner’s reporting expectations, query formats, and

escalation preferences, reducing friction in ongoing communications.

Merchant Risk Monitoring 

• Carry out day-to-day merchant risk monitoring across the Ryft portfolio — reviewing

transaction activity, volumes, and behavioural patterns to identify anomalies that may indicate fraud, policy breach, or elevated risk.

• Feed merchant risk intelligence into the fraud detection and response process, working

closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure monitoring activity informs rule tuning and threshold decisions.

• Flag merchants or sub-merchants exhibiting patterns of concern, documenting your findings clearly and escalating where a risk response is required.

• Support chargeback and dispute monitoring at the merchant level, identifying accounts with elevated dispute rates and feeding that data into the wider fraud analysis process.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of monitoring activity and risk decisions in line with FCA expectations and internal policy.

Cross-functional Collaboration 

• Work closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure partner query intelligence and merchant monitoring findings are connected — a query from an acquirer about a specific merchant should inform, and be informed by, what you’re seeing in monitoring.

• Liaise with the underwriting team where partner queries or merchant monitoring activity raises questions about how a merchant was onboarded or what their risk profile should be.

• Support the engineering and product teams with information requests related to transaction tracing, where system-level investigation requires cross-functional input.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of response templates, internal runbooks, and query management procedures.

What We’re Looking For 

Essential 

• Experience in a payments operations, risk operations, or financial crime role within a PSP,

acquirer, payment facilitator, or bank — with direct exposure to acquirer or banking partner

queries.

• Demonstrable ability to trace transactions through payment systems — you understand how a payment moves, where it can go wrong, and how to reconstruct what happened from system data.

• Strong written communication skills, with experience producing clear, structured responses to banking or regulatory counterparties who expect precision.

• An investigative mindset — you ask the next question, not just the obvious one. You’re not satisfied with a plausible explanation if the evidence doesn’t fully support it.

• Organised and reliable under query volume — able to manage multiple open cases

simultaneously without losing track of timelines or detail.

• Comfortable operating within a first line risk function with real accountability for the quality and timeliness of outputs.

Nice to Have 

• Familiarity with merchant risk monitoring in a PayFac or marketplace payments model.

• Experience with chargeback and dispute management, including TC40/SAFE data or scheme fraud reporting.

• Exposure to fraud tooling such as Fraud.net , Sift, SEON or equivalent platforms.

title: Medical Lead
description:
Are you an experienced doctor with a passion for developing others and delivering exceptional patient care? 

At Montu, we are looking for a Medical Team Lead to join our growing Clinical team, combining clinical practice with the opportunity to lead, mentor and develop a team of doctors.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys supporting others, has experience providing clinical guidance and supervision, and is confident in building strong working relationships with clinicians and consultants.

You will play a key role in supporting the professional development of our Junior Clinical Fellows (JCFs), helping them build confidence, develop greater clinical autonomy and deliver safe, high-quality patient care.

As we continue to grow, this is an opportunity to bring your clinical expertise and leadership skills into an evolving area of healthcare, helping to shape and support the next generation of clinicians while making a meaningful difference to patients' lives.

What is the job? 

As a Medical Team Lead, you will provide day-to-day leadership, support and guidance to a team of clinicians, ensuring they are well-supervised, well-supported, and progressing safely towards greater clinical autonomy. You will act as the primary link between clinicians and consultants, coordinating supervision, escalation pathways, and feedback loops so that patient care stays safe and consistent.

You will combine your own clinical practice with people leadership, taking ownership of fellow development, consultant engagement, governance, and training within your team, while working alongside other Team Leads to keep standards consistent across the wider service.

You will be the first point of contact for JCF’s requiring guidance on professional or personal development and appraisal or revalidation. You will also act as a trusted contact for consultants raising concerns about supervision and workload.

What will you be doing? 

Clinician Line Management 

- Act as the named line manager/lead for a cohort of clinicians, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, and pastoral support.

- Identify clinicians who are struggling early, and put support plans in place in collaboration with consultants and HR/medical education leads.

Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

- Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

- Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

- Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

- Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

- Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

- Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

- Full GMC Registration

- Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

- On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

- Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

- Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

- Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked.

- Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

- Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
TL;DR: As our first Executive Assistant, you'll support Conduct's founders by protecting their time, keeping priorities moving and making the company feel sharper in how it runs day to day. It's a high-trust role, close to every big decision, at a company running faster than ever.

WHY CONDUCT 

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into software systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN 

You'll work side by side with our three founders as they tackle one of the most complex problems of our generation. Their time is one of the most valuable things we have, and you'll help to decide how it gets spent. One day that means getting a CEO to a customer in Germany. The next, it's prepping a board meeting or landing a candidate we've been chasing for months. Plans often change hourly and you'll help keep everything on track. You'll be our first EA, so you'll set the standard for how we support the founders. As we grow, the team around you might too, and you'll help shape how it works. Few roles give you this view of how a generational company gets built, and as we scale, your scope grows with us.

In practice:

- Help run packed founder calendars and decide what they spend their time on

- Set up the meetings that move Conduct forward, with enterprise customers, investors and partners, and make sure everyone walks in prepared and walks out with next steps

- Plan global founder travel and fix it fast when things don’t go to plan

- Live in founder inboxes and threads, prioritising by what matters most to the business, handling what you can and flagging what you can’t

- Write on the founders' behalf to customers, investors and partners, and get every detail right

- Keep board and investor meetings running smoothly, from scheduling to follow-ups

- Help candidates have a great first experience of Conduct

- Spot what's slowing the team down and build the fix

WHO WE HIRE 

You're the person everyone goes to when something needs to get done properly. You're sharp, calm under pressure and good with people, and you'd rather be in the room where decisions happen than watching from the outside. You might already be an EA, or you might be in a role where you've quietly been doing the job of one.

In practice that tends to look like:

- You've supported founders, CEOs, or senior execs in a high-pressure, high-excellence environment, ideally a fast-scaling startup, and you know how to keep up

- You thrive when things are messy and moving fast, and you bring structure without waiting to be asked

- You're smart and proactive, and you see what's needed before anyone asks

- You're happy to push back, even with a founder, when something doesn't need to happen

- You communicate clearly and confidently, in writing and in person, whether it's an investor, a customer or a new hire

- You bring maturity and sound judgement to confidential matters

- When something doesn't work, you fix it or automate it, and you'll happily pick up work that's nowhere near your job description

- You have a zero-error mindset: anything with your name or a founder's on it is right first time, even on the busiest days

- Speaking German is a plus

title: Talent Partner
description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The role: 

Multiverse’s mission is to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. Joining us means being part of a talented team, tackling the challenges of being in a scaling organisation solving complex problems, whilst contributing to our company and product growth. As a team, we always prioritise quality - you’ll hold the hiring bar whilst keeping pipeline moving when there’s commercial pressure to move fast.

As a Talent Partner, you’ll be growing your experience as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, and own end-to-end recruitment for the roles you’re responsible for. You’ll show up prepared with market knowledge, using it to set realistic expectations on timelines, candidate availability and what the market will and won’t accept, and adjusting your approach when conditions change. You’ll use pipeline data to spot where a process is breaking down and fix it. You use AI to power your productivity, and focus your time on what AI can’t do: building strong stakeholder relationships, giving candidates an exceptional experience and building connections.

Teams you’ll support: Operations - this is our learner-facing org who work day-in-day-out to give our apprentices a great learning experience and provide measurable impact to our customers; and G&A - our core business partnering teams across People and Talent, Finance, Legal, CEO Office and Comms.

If you have experience as a recruiter or Talent Partner, ideally somewhere with a high talent bar, and are genuinely excited about being at the forefront of a fast-evolving recruiting role, we’d love for you to apply.

What you’ll do: 

- Run recruiting for your roles end-to-end: attraction and sourcing, qualifying and hiring top talent for Multiverse. We have a high hiring bar, and you’ll partner closely with managers to assess the market, calibrate regularly, build rigour into our assessment and make pivots based on data.

- Partner with hiring managers to expertly qualify requirements, challenge assumptions using market data and past hiring experience, and build a shared understanding of what good looks like.

- Design structured interview and assessment processes for the roles you own.

- Be an exceptional operator, running processes that focus on the very highest quality of hire as we scale, and make the most of your tech stack to do so. We invest in great tools (Ashby, Claude, Gemini, Juicebox, Brighthire, LinkedIn) to support you. You’ll source through these platforms and build your own network and referrals.

- Manage candidate relationships end-to-end: anticipating candidates’ needs and questions, tailoring your communication to their profile and stage in the pipeline, building buy-in and providing high quality, timely feedback. You’ll own candidate experience and maintain strong NPS, and build talent pools from silver medallists.

- Analyse pipeline data to identify where a hiring process is breaking down, and use those insights to adjust your sourcing or process.

- Partner with your colleagues across the People and Talent team to ensure we’re collectively driving the right talent outcomes for Multiverse.

We value competence more than years of experience, but you’ll most likely have the following to be successful:

What you’ll bring: 

- You embody our Operating Principles in how you work.

- Proven experience in a recruiting or Talent Partner role, supporting multiple hiring managers, ideally in a scaling, highly agile business environment.

- You can credibly partner with managers, and are confident using market knowledge to advise constructively.

- You can evaluate candidates effectively, and stay regularly calibrated with your hiring team. You can point to where you’ve designed or improved structured assessment and coached managers.

- You build strong candidate relationships, understanding skills, motivations and decision criteria, and handle feedback conversations well.

- You’re comfortable with data, and use it alongside qualitative feedback to spot problems and change course.

- You are highly motivated and autonomous, but curious to learn and ask questions where you don’t know.

- You are building AI into your everyday workflows, and are rigorous in your approach to data hygiene to ensure good tools are built on even better data, and verify the outputs.

Why this role may not be for you 

- You don’t want to run things end-to-end. You’ll own your hires and how to deliver them here.

- You struggle with ambiguity; our business and skills requirements are evolving fast and we need to navigate through that with our hiring managers.

- You don’t get your energy speaking to candidates. We are building an AI-first team with the explicit intention of spending more time where it matters, in the market, speaking with top talent.

Benefits 

- Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

- Health & Wellness - private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

- Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

- Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

- Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked! 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here .

Our Commitment to Safeguarding 

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy , our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
About Nabla 

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role 

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer .

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities 

- Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

- Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

- Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

- Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

- Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

- Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications 

- 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

- Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

- Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

- Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

- Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

- Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

- Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla 

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. 

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla 

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel 

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble 

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift 

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity 

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion 

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Missions principales 

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %) 

- Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

- Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

- Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

- Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

- Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

- Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %) 

- Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

- Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

- Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %) 

- Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

- Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

- Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %) 

- Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

- Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché 

Formation et expérience 

- Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques 

- Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

- Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

- Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

- Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

- Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts 

- Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

- Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

- Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

- Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles 

- Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

- Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

- Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

Context and role 

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals.

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. - Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar.
- Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions.

- Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects.
