title: Head of Go-to-Market, AI Care Operations
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

- 
Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

- 
Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

- 
Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

AI Care Operations (previously Sword Intelligence), is Sword's AI care management division. We don't deliver a clinical program to members. We deploy AI Care Managers, trained on more than 14 million real care interactions, to run the operations of providers, payers and national health systems.

It started as an internal problem. On the way to freeing over a million people from pain, Sword hit the same wall every healthcare organization does: we didn't have enough hands to scale the care we needed to provide. Instead of hiring our way out, we built AI to do it, certified it for clinical use, and ran it in our own operations before offering it to anyone else.

Today we sell two families of solutions:

- Triage — a certified Clinical Triage Line that guides every patient to the right care, 24/7, across voice and digital channels.

- Care Orchestration — care navigation, population health campaigns (screenings, vaccinations, medication adherence), surgery prehab and rehab, and readmission prevention.

We've announced a partnership with the Hellenic Ministry of Health to build an AI-powered front door for Greece's 10 million citizens, and we work with other national health systems, health plans and providers across the US and Europe. The US is now our biggest growth opportunity, and this role is central to capturing it.

The role

We are hiring a Head of Go-to-Market for AI Care Operations in the US. The role sits at the intersection of product marketing, competitive intelligence and commercial enablement. It is one of the leadership roles on the AI Care Operations team, reporting to the General Manager.

Here's the opportunity. "AI agents for healthcare" is one of the most crowded categories in the market right now. Voice AI startups, EHR vendors, care management platforms and outsourcers all claim to automate care operations, and to a buyer they can sound alike. Very few of them have certified medical devices, national-scale partnerships, or AI proven on hundreds of thousands of their own members before it was sold to anyone else. We have all three. Your job is to make that difference unmistakable.

You will own three things:

- Make our value impossible to miss. Build the narrative, positioning and competitive differentiation that make it obvious why AI Care Operations is categorically better than AI point solutions, legacy nurse lines and call centers, and the care management platforms buyers already have. That means the core messaging architecture across Triage and Care Orchestration, positioning by buyer (health plan, health system, value-based care, employer, government), battle cards, ROI frameworks, and the demos and proof that move a skeptical COO or VP of Care Management.

- Make sure the commercial team can tell that story. Sword's segment sales teams sell many solutions and can't be experts in all of them. When the health plan team is in front of a Medicare Advantage plan, or the employer team is pitching a front door for a self-insured population, they come to you to scope the workflows, walk the buyer through how the agents actually work, and answer the hard questions on safety, integration and ROI.

- Find, surface and pursue the opportunities. You will canvass the US and international markets systematically for the accounts, RFPs, procurements, contract renewals and budget signals that would otherwise go unnoticed: a health plan rebuilding its care management operation, a health system under readmission penalties, a state agency tendering a nurse line. You'll use AI tooling to do this faster and wider than a traditional GTM team could, then partner with the relevant segment leader to make sure each opportunity is pursued and won.

AI proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword, and every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework: Explorer (uses AI daily for personal productivity), Builder (creates workflows and tools that lift the whole team) and Integrator (embeds AI into products and processes at scale). This role requires Builder at minimum. Come ready with real examples.

What you'll be doing

- Core positioning, messaging house and narrative architecture for AI Care Operations and each of its solutions

- The category story: why AI care management that does the work beats both headcount and AI tools that only assist the people doing it

- Competitive intelligence and battle cards across voice AI and agentic AI vendors, nurse line and call center outsourcers, and care management platforms

- Buyer-facing materials: one-pagers, ROI and capacity calculators, demo scripts and recorded agent calls, case studies, RFP response library, sales decks

- Proof architecture: turning deployments into case studies and outcome metrics (contacts handled, cost per interaction, gap closure, time to care, readmissions) that a CFO will sign off on

- Solution specialist team (direct reports), paired with segment sales reps across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government

- Sales and customer success enablement: training, playbooks, discovery guides, certification on each solution

- Market opportunity mapping and systematic canvassing across US segments, with a lighter watch on international tenders

- Message consistency across Sword's commercial segments and geographies, including where AI Care Operations is sold as part of the broader AI Care platform

- Voice of the market into product: what buyers ask for, where we lose, and what competitors are shipping

We'd love to see

You are currently at, or recently from, a Lead, Head, Director or VP-level GTM or product marketing role where you owned the full stack: launching products, positioning, competitive differentiation, sales enablement and market strategy. You've built things that measurably changed how deals were won.

You can sell something that isn't a product category yet. AI Care Operations is bought by operations leaders, not benefits leaders, and it competes with a budget line (headcount, outsourcing) as much as with other vendors. You know how to make the case that replacing work is different from adding a tool, and you can tell a clean story across several solutions without it sounding like a platform pitch that means nothing.

You think in first principles. Faced with a new buyer, your instinct is to ask what operational problem they actually have, why our agents solve it better than more staff or another vendor, and what evidence would make a skeptical COO believe it. You don't reach for a template.

You are genuinely AI-fluent, not performatively. You've built your own workflows and loops with AI tools for market intelligence, opportunity canvassing and competitive research. You'll also be selling AI, so you need to understand how our agents work well enough to explain their limits honestly.

You write well and think clearly. Your materials are the kind a VP of Care Management reads and thinks "these people have run a care operation."

You are close to the field. You've sat in on deals, heard objections live, and changed your strategy because of what buyers said rather than what you assumed.

Requirements

- 7+ years in product marketing and/or GTM, with clear ownership of positioning and competitive strategy, and current or recent Lead, Head, Director or VP scope

- Demonstrated ownership of all three: product marketing and positioning, GTM strategy, and sales, field or revenue enablement

- Experience selling to operational buyers (COOs, VPs of operations or care management, contact center leaders) rather than only end users or benefits teams

- Evidence of working cross-functionally with sales and customer success, not only corporate marketing, and of building competitive intelligence from scratch rather than inheriting it

- Based in the US

Strong signal backgrounds

- B2B healthcare software and AI companies with strong commercial engines selling to health systems and payers

- Medical device and health technology companies that sell regulated, certified products into providers and payers

- Automation and AI companies whose products replace operational work

- Has positioned an AI or automation product that replaces labor, and built ROI cases a CFO accepted

- Has built competitive displacement narratives that demonstrably changed win rates

- Has used AI tooling to drive market canvassing and opportunity identification at scale

- Experience with multi-solution, multi-segment GTM, including public sector procurement

How success is measured

This is not a quota-carrying role, but it is not a soft one. You'll be held to:

- Qualified pipeline sourced from your canvassing, by segment and pillar

- Competitive win rate, and win rate on deals where a solution specialist was involved

- Bookings influenced across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government

- Sales cycle length from first meeting to signed pilot or contract

- Enablement adoption: how many reps can pitch, demo and handle objections on each pillar without help

This role can sit remotely and the compensation range will be adjusted to accurately reflect the country in which the candidate resides 

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role. 

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact. 

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation. 

Total Compensation Range

$145,000 — $330,000 USD 

Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately. 

Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender

Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience scaling sales organizations across territories, countries, or customer segments.

title: Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

What you will be doing

Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.

Architecture and design

• Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates

• Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers

• Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined

• Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others

Hands-on build

• Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI

• Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction

• Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale

• Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it

• Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes

• Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them

Data modernisation and migration

• Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code

• Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

• Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new

Security, access control and assurance

• Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration

• Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material

• Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why

Client-facing delivery and enablement

• Work as an embedded member of a small delivery team, frequently alongside client engineers and other suppliers

• Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks

• Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought

• Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets

Essential

• Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework

• MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced

• Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery

• API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems

• Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes

• Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud

• Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review

• UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it

For architect-level roles we additionally expect:

• Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code

• Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one

Desirable

• UK public sector, or another regulated and security-conscious environment

• Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing

• Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover

• Domain-driven design and bounded-context analysis; monolith decomposition

• Attribute-based access control and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Casbin, XACML-based systems)

• Field-level or client-side encryption, key management, HSM/KMS and KMIP integration

• Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns

• Metadata standards such as DCAT or Dublin Core; data cataloguing, data mesh and federated data architecture concepts

• Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)

• Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity

• Time-series or geospatial data; deployment to constrained or edge hardware

• AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools

Working context

Engagement Contract. Typically three to twelve months per programme, with a strong likelihood of rolling onto the next. Some roles begin part-time through a design phase before going full-time for build.

Clearance SC clearance is the standard requirement for these roles, and current SC will always be the fastest route onto a programme. We will consider especially strong candidates who hold BPSS only and can sponsor SC in those cases, though clearance takes roughly three months and start dates will reflect that.

Residency UK resident. All work on these programmes is delivered from the UK by UK-onshore staff.

Working model Predominantly remote with periodic onsite attendance. Locations vary by programme — expect occasional travel to client sites including London, Manchester and Leeds.

Environment Work is typically delivered through client-supplied devices or VDI, with VPN access to client environments. You should be comfortable operating within defined information-handling and access constraints, and with the pace that government security and onboarding processes set.

Team shape Small, focused, multi-disciplinary teams. On several programmes gravity9 delivers alongside partner organisations and other suppliers, and you will need to work effectively across those boundaries.

Timing These roles support a growing pipeline of central government work. Some engagements are contracted and mobilising; others are in contract negotiation with expected start dates in the coming months. We are building the bench now so that we can mobilise quickly, and clearance lead times mean early conversations are worthwhile even where a start date is not yet fixed.

You will carry out Military Airworthiness Reviews (Mil ARs) on Typhoon Air Systems under the RAF MAR contract, giving the RAF independent, evidence-based assurance that continuing airworthiness is being managed in line with regulation. Your judgements are your own: you set the sample, raise and classify findings, and report outcomes on the evidence, without direction from the customer or from Baines Simmons. Once authorised, you will also carry out Technical Compliance (TC) checks of other surveyors' reports, helping to keep the quality of the whole programme high.

· Produce accurate, evidence-based Mil AR reports within the timescales set out in the contract.

· Deliver Mil ARs at deployed and overseas locations as required, working within CONDO regulations and local security arrangements.

· Maintain your Mil AR authorisations, platform currency and continuation training, and complete any training needed for additional platform authorisations you take on.

· Handle all contract and MOD-owned information in line with JSP 440 and TrustFlight information security requirements.

· Support the wider RAF MAR team by sharing lessons identified, contributing to the annual review meeting and mentoring less experienced surveyors.

title: Front-End Team Lead
description:
At DigiTickets, we provide ticketing and operational systems for many of the UK’s leading visitor attractions. We’re looking for a talented and driven Front-End Team Leader to lead the development and evolution of our front-end architecture across web, mobile, and POS interfaces.

This is a senior technical and leadership role, focused on driving delivery, improving front-end performance and user experience, and ensuring design consistency and technical excellence across the product suite. You’ll guide a small team of front-end developers and collaborate closely with UX/UI, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver high-quality user-facing features.

Benefits 

- Holidays: 25-30 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), with increased entitlement based on service. 

- Competitive Salary: Up £52,000 - £58,000 based on experience 

- Nest Pension scheme 

- Discretionary company bonus 

- Annual Training Allowance: Receive support for certifications and professional development. 

- Birthday Leave: Enjoy a day off on your birthday to celebrate. 

- Team Outings & Events: Be part of a collaborative and social team culture. 

Key Responsibilities 

Leadership & Team Development 

- Lead and mentor a team of front-end developers, promoting best practices, clean code, and design consistency.

- Plan and manage delivery cycles in coordination with Product, UX, and QA teams.

- Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture within the team.

- Support the professional development and progression of front-end engineers.

Technical Ownership 

- Own and evolve the front-end architecture for DigiTickets’ core platforms (web, mobile, and POS).

- Drive improvements in front-end performance, accessibility, and responsiveness.

- Establish and maintain scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.

- Champion modern front-end technologies, frameworks, and tooling.

Collaboration & Delivery 

- Translate product and UX requirements into robust, user-friendly technical solutions.

- Collaborate closely with the UX/UI and Product teams to ensure a cohesive user experience across platforms.

- Work with back-end teams to align API integration and interface logic.

- Provide input into feature planning, release management, and product roadmap discussions.

Code Quality & Standards 

- Ensure adherence to coding standards, testing frameworks, and documentation practices.

- Implement and maintain automated front-end testing pipelines (unit, integration, E2E).

- Conduct regular code reviews and performance audits.

Stakeholder Communication 

- Communicate technical progress, risks, and blockers to internal stakeholders.

- Work with Support, Sales, and Client Services to assist with technical queries and demos when required.

- Provide visibility into front-end priorities and status across departments.

Required Skills & Experience 

- 4+ years of professional experience in front-end development, with 1+ years in a leadership or mentoring role.

- Deep expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue.js, React, or Angular), with a strong preference for Vue.js.

- Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design best practices.

- Experience working with design systems and scalable UI architecture.

- Solid understanding of performance optimisation, accessibility (WCAG), and cross-browser compatibility.

- Comfortable working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile methodologies.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Desirable 

- Experience working with SaaS products, ticketing, or eCommerce platforms.

- Familiarity with backend integration using GraphQL.

- Experience with TypeScript, Vue, and similar tools.

- Knowledge of testing frameworks such as Cypress, Vitest, or Jest.

- Understanding of mobile/responsive UI development and/or hybrid app frameworks (e.g., Capacitor or Ionic).

title: Responsable commercial régional
description:
Description de l'équipe

SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. La personne retenue dirigera et développera une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en assurant personnellement des acquisitions dans un premier temps tout en construisant la structure, la culture et le modèle de coaching qui porteront la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.

Vos missions

- 
Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché

- 
Porter les objectifs d'acquisition de revenus de la région, piloter le portefeuille de marchands acquis et le développer par la vente croisée et la montée en gamme

- 
Fixer le niveau d'exigence en matière de performance commerciale, en ancrant une culture de coaching et de responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe terrain

- 
Façonner les outils de vente, du support de présentation aux contenus d'accompagnement, pour permettre à l'équipe de rivaliser et de gagner

- 
Maintenir une présence forte sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes

- 
Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement

Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…

- 
Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable

- 
Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer

- 
Solide connaissance des services aux marchands, des paiements, des systèmes de point de vente ou de la vente auprès des PME, par exemple dans l'hôtellerie ou le voyage

- 
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une crédibilité reconnue pour évoluer dans des environnements multiculturels et face à des parties prenantes variées

- 
Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance

Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp

🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Ce poste implique des déplacements réguliers pour accompagner votre équipe sur le territoire 🌈 Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion : faites partie d'un environnement de travail qui valorise et promeut la diversité, favorisant un cadre inclusif où les perspectives de chacun sont respectées et accueillies 🚀 Adhésion à notre programme d'options d'achat d'actions virtuelles (VSOP) : vous détiendrez une participation dans le succès futur de SumUp 📚 Un budget annuel dédié de 2000 € pour votre développement personnel, utilisable pour assister à des conférences et/ou faire progresser votre carrière grâce à une formation complémentaire 💼 Sécurité financière : des cotisations de retraite d'entreprise qui soutiennent votre avenir à long terme 🏥 Accompagnement santé : nous prenons en charge 50 % du coût mensuel de votre assurance santé (Mutuelle et Prévoyance) 🚌 Avantages supplémentaires : nous proposons des titres restaurant (Swile) et prenons en charge vos frais de transport 🏖 Congés généreux : profitez de 25 jours de congés payés, ainsi que des jours fériés et des jours de congés spéciaux 🎉 Petits déjeuners réguliers, événements d'équipe, fêtes de bureau et activités sportives 🌴 Break4me : un mois sabbatique après 3 ans d'ancienneté 🔗 Prime de cooptation : bénéficiez de récompenses supplémentaires en recommandant des talents pour rejoindre l'équipe SumUp

À propos de SumUp

Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.

Chez SumUp, notre mission est d'accompagner les petites entreprises du monde entier en leur proposant des outils simples et accessibles qui leur permettent de prospérer. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 millions d'entreprises dans 39 marchés font confiance à SumUp comme partenaire financier pour gérer leurs paiements, leurs finances et leurs relations clients.

Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans notre équipe diversifiée de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. Nos valeurs fondamentales constituent le socle de notre identité et de nos convictions, façonnant notre culture de travail et portant notre réussite. Nous cultivons l'inclusion et une culture d'apprentissage continu, en offrant un espace sûr pour l'épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nos différences font notre unicité et notre force, à mesure que nous œuvrons à créer un environnement où chacun se sent à sa place et soutenu, quelle que soit son identité.

SumUp est fier d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, recherchant et accueillant activement la diversité au sein de ses équipes. Nous ne fondons nos décisions de recrutement ou d'emploi sur aucun critère de race, de couleur, de religion ou de conviction religieuse, d'origine ethnique ou nationale, de nationalité, de sexe, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, de handicap, d'âge, ou de tout autre critère protégé par la loi applicable ou interdit par la politique de l'entreprise. Notre engagement va au delà du recrutement pour créer un lieu de travail sûr et respectueux, où toute forme de harcèlement est strictement interdite. Découvrez-en davantage sur notre culture et nos opportunités sur notre site carrières , et suivez notre actualité sur LinkedIn , Instagram et TikTok .

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) indépendant
description:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l’opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

- 
Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

- 
Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

- 
Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

- 
Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

- 
Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

- 
Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

- 
Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

- 
Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

- 
Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

- 
Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

- 
Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

- 
Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

- 
Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

- 
La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

- 
Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

- 
La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.

- 
Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

- 
La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

- 
Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

- 
Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s’agit d’une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l’activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

- 
Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

- 
Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

- 
Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

- 
Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

- 
Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

- 
Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.

Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.

title: Growth - France (CDD)
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time.

This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth.

You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

This role will own:

- Winning new business

- Go-to-market strategy and execution

- Client onboarding and implementation support

- Account management and expansion

What you will be doing

- Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success)

- Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.)

- Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue

- Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation and launch strategies

- Managing post-implementation relationships with clients after go-live, driving continuous improvement and opportunity to deepen engagement or grow the account

- Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements

- Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments

- Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness

- Operating with low structure and high ownership: remove friction, avoid bureaucracy, move fast

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

- Initial interview

- Take-home exercise

- Final interview (in-person)

- Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Energy Markets - France (CDD)
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

- Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

- Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

- Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

- Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

- Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

- Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

- Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

- Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

- Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

- Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

- Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

In addition this team supports identifying and pursuing opportunities to drive growth and business impact for our international business.

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️ 

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. 

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan .

About the Enterprise segment 

- Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

- Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

- Total Addressable Market: ~ 7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan 

- Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

- Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

- Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

- HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

- Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐ 

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine .

More precisely, you will:

- Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment .

- Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

- Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

- Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations , rigorous follow‑up , and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

- Be on the field with the team : prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

- Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals : strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

- Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range .

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐ 

You may be a great fit at Alan if you: 

- Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales , with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

- Have experience leading and coaching sales teams , with the ability to set a high bar , give clear direction , and help people grow 

- Have full working proficiency in French , and advanced level in English for internal communication

- Have a very hands‑on mentality : you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

- Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals 

- Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments , and can prioritize ruthlessly 

- Are data‑driven and analytical : you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

- Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

- Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area 

Nice-to-have: 

- Experience selling to HR or Finance 

.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer: 

- Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

- Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

- All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

- Delightful healthcare insurance . Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only. 

- Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits.

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply !

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
ANINE BING is looking for a Senior FP&A Analyst to join our Finance team based in Paris .

As a senior member of our Paris HQ Finance team, the Senior FP&A Analyst holds the full view of the company P&L, from net sales to EBITDA, across all channels and regions. The role combines ownership of the planning and reporting cycles with hands-on business partnering, and plays a central part in structuring our FP&A processes as the brand scales internationally.

We're looking for a rigorous, process-oriented finance professional with a strong retail background and a sharp understanding of margin mechanics. You are comfortable owning the numbers end to end and challenging the business on what drives them.

This is a full-time permanent position (CDI) based at our Paris HQ ( with 4 days per week in the office and 1 day of remote work possible ). The role reports to the Head of Finance .

Responsibilities Include: 

- Full P&L ownership: own the company-wide P&L view, from net sales through gross margin, store contribution and operating expenses down to EBITDA, consolidated across retail, e-commerce and wholesale, and across the US, Europe and Asia. Act as the go-to reference on P&L performance and its drivers for the Head of Finance and the leadership team.

- Budgeting & forecasting: lead the annual budget, monthly reforecasts and long-range plan. Own the planning calendar, key assumptions and models, and consolidate inputs from regional and functional stakeholders.

- Margin management: own margin analysis at every level (channel, market, category, collection, SKU), including markdowns, promotions, cost of goods, freight, duties, FX and inventory provisions. Build margin bridges, explain variances and drive recommendations on pricing and markdown strategy.

- Monthly close & reporting: own the FP&A month-end close and the global management reporting package (actuals vs. budget, forecast and prior year, variance commentary, KPI dashboards). Work with Accounting to ensure management and statutory figures reconcile.

- Business partnering: serve as finance partner to Retail, E-Commerce, Wholesale, Merchandising and Supply Chain leaders on store P&Ls, inventory productivity and open-to-buy, pricing, promotional plans, and business cases for store openings and market entries.

- Processes & controls: design, document and continuously improve FP&A processes, templates, review controls and data standards. Drive reporting automation across the finance stack (NetSuite, Excel / Google Sheets, BI tools) in coordination with Accounting and IT.

- Leadership support: prepare materials for executive and board reviews and lead ad hoc analyses requested by the CFO and the Head of Finance. Review and guide the work of junior team members.

Requirements: 

- 5–7 years of experience in FP&A, controlling or financial planning, with significant exposure to a company-wide or business-unit scope.

- Retail experience is mandatory: proven experience in a retail or fashion company with a store network and multi-channel model, and a solid command of store economics, seasonality, markdowns, inventory and open-to-buy.

- Full P&L vision: hands-on experience owning or co-owning a full P&L, from top line to EBITDA, including consolidation across channels or countries.

- Strong margin expertise: gross margin building blocks, markdown and promotional impact, landed cost, inventory valuation and provisions, with the ability to explain margin drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

- Rigorous and process-oriented: a track record of building or improving planning, closing and reporting processes, with reliable delivery against deadlines.

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and financial modeling skills; experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a plus) and a BI or reporting tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau or equivalent).

- Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.

- Fluent English required (global scope, US HQ, international teams); professional proficiency in French preferred.

- Strong communication skills: able to turn complex analyses into concise, decision-oriented messages and to challenge senior operational stakeholders with confidence

Benefits & Perks

ANINE BING is a Los Angeles-based fashion house founded in 2012 that blends elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy to offer modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to everyday style. title: Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa
description:
The Role 

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery 

- Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
- Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
- Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
- Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
- Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.
Case management and coordination 

- Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
- Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
- Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
- Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.
Clinical risk oversight and governance 

- Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
- Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
- Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
- Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.
Clinical protocols and client enablement 

- Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
- Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
- Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.
Client relationship, insights and reporting 

- Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
- Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
- Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.
Requirements 

- Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
- Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
- Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
- Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
- Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
- Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
- Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.
Desirable 

- Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
- Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
- Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
- Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
- Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.

In this role, you’ll: 

- Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

- Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

- Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

- Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

- Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

- Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

- Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

- The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Technical Skills

- Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

- Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise 

- Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

- Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

- Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills 

- Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

- Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

- Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

- Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities 

- Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

- Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

- Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

- Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

- Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

- Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

- Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

- Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

- Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes 

- Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

- Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

- Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

- Collaborative and willing to work across teams

- Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker] 

- Previous experience using Chainalysis products

- Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

- Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

- Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

- Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

- Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis 
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

description:

Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com . 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do: 

The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.

About the Role: 

As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights & Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.

In this role, you will: 

- Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).

- Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.

- Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.

- Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.

- Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.

- Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.

- Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.

Who You Are: 

- 3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.

- Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.

- Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.

- Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

- Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.

- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.

- Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.

- Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.

- Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.

Preferred: 

- Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.

- Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP/IP.

- Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.

- Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.

- Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

- You’re comfortable going one layer deeper than the demo - whether that’s a networking topology, a training job that won’t converge, or a rack layout question from a facilities team.

- You’ve worked across more than one layer of the stack and find the intersections more interesting than any single discipline.

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment and take ownership of your region like it’s your own business.

- You’re a natural collaborator who makes the people around you - including your AE and AM - better at their jobs.

Why CoreWeave? 

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

- Be Curious at Your Core 

- Act Like an Owner 

- Empower Employees 

- Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences 

- Achieve More Together 

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). 

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results. 

What We Offer 

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

- Life Assurance at 4x Salary

- Work culture focused on innovative disruption
