Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description:
TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Ce que nous vous offrons 

- Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

- Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

- Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

- Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : 

Rattachement hiérarchique 

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

Mission principale 

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES 

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température 

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

Étude et déploiement des matériels 

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation 

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

Gestion des fournisseurs 

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

Qualité et amélioration continue 

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES 

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : 

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES 

En interne 

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe 

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

PROFIL RECHERCHE 

Formation 

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience 

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques 

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles 

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste 

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

- Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Ernährungswissenschaften / Ernährungsberatung (FH oder Bachelor BFH / FFHS) oder eine entsprechende Schweizer SRK-Anerkennung eines ausländischen Diploms.

- Erfahrung in der Beratung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit Adipositas und gewichtsbezogenen Erkrankungen (inkl. moderner Therapieformen wie GLP-1-Medikamenten).

description:

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world.

Our culture 

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. - Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of the infrastructure that runs every customer’s build, test, and CI job on Namespace.

- Build observability, alerting, and incident response processes that identify and resolve issues before they affect customers.

- Drive capacity planning and cost efficiency, so we continue to deliver infrastructure that is both faster and more cost-effective.

- Collaborate closely with product engineers to ship new capabilities quickly and safely.

What we're looking for 

- Strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience operating production infrastructure at scale.

- Deep knowledge of Linux, networking, and storage, plus experience with tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar.

- Proficiency in Go, Python, or a similar language, automation is paramount.

You can expect: 

- Competitive salary and stock options

Life at Namespace Labs: 

- We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

- We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do 

- Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

- Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

- Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

- Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

- Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

- Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements 

- Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

- Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

- Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

- Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

- A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

- Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

- Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

- High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

- Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

- Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have 

- A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

- Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

- Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

- Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

- Open-source firmware contributions.

- Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

- Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

- Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

- Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

- Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if: 

- You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

- You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

- You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if: 

- You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

- You would forward output you cannot explain.

- "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

- Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

- Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

- Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

- Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

- Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

- Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

- Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

- A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

- Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Characterization Lead
description:
At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan.

Responsabilities 

· Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

· Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos.

· Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior.

· Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements.

· Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions.

· Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits.

· Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions.

· Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening.

Essential Experience 

· 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion.

· Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product.

· Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation.

· Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis.

· Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts.

· Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging.

· Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards.

· BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams.

Essential Experience 

· Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs.

· Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin.

· Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified.

· Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications.

· Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization.

· MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity.

title: Lead Software Engineering
description:

People & team 
Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie.

Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren.

Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output.

Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken.

Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso.

We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak.

Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren.

- heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten;

- heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers;

- kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen;

- begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge;

- heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving;

- vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties;

- volg je ontwikkelingen rondom AI, AI-agents en Agentic Engineering;

- beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Java, cloud, architectuur of software engineering zijn mooi meegenomen, maar voor ons zijn je ervaring en wat je daadwerkelijk hebt gebouwd en geleid belangrijker.

Waarom deze rol interessant is 

Dit is een rol voor iemand die op een punt is gekomen waarop alleen zelf software bouwen niet meer genoeg is, maar die óók niet de hele dag in managementmeetings wil zitten.

adesso Nederland is met ongeveer 100 collega's compact genoeg om echt invloed te hebben, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 13.000 collega's. Daardoor combineren we korte lijnen en ondernemerschap met de kennis, klanten en mogelijkheden van een grote Europese IT-organisatie.

En Software Engineering verandert snel. AI-agents gaan steeds meer onderdelen van de software lifecycle ondersteunen, van requirements en architectuur tot development, testing en delivery. Daardoor verschuift het werk van engineers naar het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, en het orkestreren, beoordelen en bijsturen van AI. 

Binnen adesso willen we daar niet vanaf de zijlijn naar kijken. Als Lead Software Engineering help je mede bepalen hoe we deze ontwikkeling vertalen naar onze engineers, onze projecten en onze klanten.

Klaar om niet alleen goede software te bouwen, maar ook het team eromheen sterker te maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Employee Relations & Compliance

Data & Business Insights

Education

title: Stagiair(e) Flight Dispatcher
description:
Stage Junior Flight dispatcher bij dnata – Schiphol 

Jij wilt de luchtvaart in. Maar weet jij ook wat er allemaal geregeld moet worden voordat een vliegtuig kan vertrekken? 

Als Junior Flight dispatcher bij dnata ontdek je het! Je werkt midden in de dynamische wereld van Schiphol en speelt achter de schermen een belangrijke rol bij de voorbereiding van onze vluchten. Geen dag is hetzelfde, je leert ontzettend veel en je werkt samen met collega’s die net zo enthousiast zijn over de luchtvaart als jij.

Volg jij de opleiding Aviation Operations (mbo-niveau 4) , bijvoorbeeld bij het ROC van Amsterdam (Hoofddorp), STC Rotterdam of een andere onderwijsinstelling, en zit je in je laatste leerjaar? Ben je op zoek naar een uitdagende eindstage in de luchtvaart? Dan is een stage als Junior Flight dispatcher bij dnata op Schiphol misschien wel iets voor jou!

Wat ga je doen? 

Een vliegtuig vertrekt niet zomaar. Achter iedere vlucht zit een hoop voorbereiding en daar speel jij een belangrijke rol in!

Tijdens je stage leer je onder andere hoe je:

· Alle belangrijke vluchtgegevens verzamelt en controleert.

· Wijzigingen in vluchten volgt en ervoor zorgt dat de juiste informatie op tijd bij de juiste personen terechtkomt.

· Werkt met verschillende systemen waarin vlucht- en passagiersgegevens worden verwerkt.

· Samenwerkt met verschillende afdelingen om vluchten zo soepel mogelijk af te handelen.

· De belading van een vliegtuig berekent en leert werken met het loadsheet, volgens de geldende voorschriften en onder de juiste begeleiding en bevoegdheden.

Je krijgt steeds meer inzicht in wat er nodig is om een vlucht veilig en volgens planning te laten vertrekken. Je leert verantwoordelijkheid nemen, nauwkeurig werken en omgaan met onverwachte veranderingen.

Kortom: je zit midden in de actie en ontdekt hoe het er achter de schermen van de luchtvaart écht aan toegaat! 

Wie zoeken we? 

We zoeken iemand die enthousiast is over de luchtvaart, graag nieuwe dingen leert en niet bang is om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Jij:

· Volgt de opleiding Aviation Operations, mbo-niveau 4 , bij ROC Hoofddorp of STC Rotterdam.

· Zit in je laatste leerjaar en zoekt een eindstage.

· Bent minimaal 18 jaar oud.

· Bent leergierig, nauwkeurig, flexibel en stressbestendig.

· Spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels. Tijdens de selectieprocedure testen we je taalvaardigheid.

· Kunt zelfstandig werken, maar functioneert ook goed in een team.

· Hebt een geldig rijbewijs, omdat je voor bepaalde werkzaamheden op het platform moet kunnen rijden.

· Je hebt geen bijbaan al op Schiphol.

· Voldoet aan de voorwaarden voor de benodigde veiligheidsscreening en Schipholpas.

Schiphol draait 24/7. Jij dus ook! 

Vliegtuigen vertrekken op alle momenten van de dag en nacht. Daarom is het belangrijk dat je 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week zelfstandig op Schiphol kunt komen . Ook als je vroeg in de ochtend begint, laat in de avond klaar bent of tijdens het weekend en op feestdagen werkt.

Je moet dus zelf een betrouwbare manier hebben om op ieder moment van de dag of nacht op de luchthaven te komen en weer thuis te komen. Alleen afhankelijk zijn van het openbaar vervoer is hiervoor niet voldoende.

Hoe ziet jouw stage eruit? 

· Duur: 5 maanden.

· Uren: gemiddeld 38 uur per week, verdeeld over gemiddeld 5 dagen.

· Rooster: wisselende diensten, inclusief nachten, weekenden en feestdagen.

· Start van je stage: tijdens de eerste maand ben je volledig beschikbaar voor trainingen en je inwerkprogramma.

Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s die je wegwijs maken in het vak. Stap voor stap leer je de werkzaamheden kennen en ontwikkel je de kennis en vaardigheden die je nodig hebt als Junior Flight dispatcher.

What’s in it for you? 

Naast een super leerzame stage krijg je bij dnata:

· Een kijkje achter de schermen van de internationale luchtvaart.

· Praktijkervaring op een van de meest dynamische luchthavens van Europa.

· Begeleiding van ervaren professionals.

· De kans om jezelf zowel professioneel als persoonlijk te ontwikkelen.

· Een internationale werkomgeving waarin teamwork belangrijk is.

· Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding en kans op een contract na je stage.

Klaar om jouw vleugels uit te slaan? 

Wil jij ontdekken of Flight dispatch bij jou past en ervaring opdoen in de wereld van de luchtvaart? Dan is dit jouw kans!

Solliciteer via www.werkenbijdnata.nl en upload je cv en motivatiebrief.

Onze afdeling Recruitment beoordeelt je sollicitatie. Ben je een geschikte kandidaat? Dan nodigen we je uit voor een recruitmentdag, waar we je graag beter leren kennen.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
description:
About the Team 

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role 

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees 

In this role, you will: 

- Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

- Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

- Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

- Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

- Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

- Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

- Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

- Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You might thrive in this role if you: 

- Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

- Are fluent in both German and English

- Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

- Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

- Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

- Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

- Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

- Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

- Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

- Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

About OpenAI 

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Salesforce Developer (UI/UX)
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

12-month fixed-term contract | Global Revenue Systems and AI Team | 

About the Role 

Our reps spend most of their day in Salesforce, and how it feels to use directly affects how much they sell. We're hiring a Salesforce Developer with a UI/UX focus to redesign the rep experience across our Sales and Revenue teams. You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive.

This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result.

What You Will Do 

Redesign the rep experience 

- Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

- Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption.

- Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building.

Build with LWC 

- Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces.

- Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions.

- Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends.

Make it stick 

- Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results.

- Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed.

- Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build.

Work as part of the global team 

- Work within the global team's standards for source control, code review, sandboxes and release management.

- Partner with admins, architects and data teams so UI changes fit the wider data model, security model and automation.

- Pass on what you learn about Lightning UX patterns and LWC best practices to the wider team.

What You Will Need 

Must have 

- Strong, demonstrable experience building Lightning Web Components in production.

- Solid Apex, SOQL and Salesforce data model knowledge to support your components.

- Deep knowledge of Lightning Experience customisation: App Builder, Dynamic Forms, page layouts, console apps and Flows.

- Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process.

- A UX mindset: you start from user problems, can explain design decisions, and can take feedback from non-technical users.

- Clear communication and the ability to work independently across time zones in a global team.

Nice to have 

- Portfolio or examples of Salesforce UI work you've shipped (screenshots or demos are ideal).

- Experience with SLDS, Figma or similar prototyping tools, and accessibility (WCAG) principles.

- Experience in Sales Cloud, especially rep-facing workflows such as opportunity management, account planning and pipeline views.

- Jest testing for LWC, and Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder).

- Experience with performance profiling and optimisation in Lightning pages.

What Success Looks Like (12 Months) 

- Month 3: UX audit complete and a prioritised roadmap agreed with Sales leadership.

- Month 6: First wave of redesigned pages and components live for a pilot group, with adoption and feedback baselined.

- Month 12: Redesigned experience rolled out to target teams, a maintained component library in place, and full documentation handed to the global team.

What we offer

- 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

- Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

- Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

- Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

- Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

- Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

- 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

- 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

- Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

- A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

- Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) Gebäude-Energieberatung – Aufbau neuer Standort im Umland
company: ENERDOMO Erfurt, Weimar, Gotha, Arnstadt und Sömmerda
description:
Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Möchten Sie ein Unternehmen als Geschäftsführer in unserem Franchise leiten und dabei eine Aufgabe übernehmen, die wirtschaftlich attraktiv ist und echten Sinn stiftet? Dann könnte diese Chance für Sie passen – insbesondere, wenn Sie aus einer dieser Regionen kommen:

- Erfurt

- Weimar

- Gotha

- Arnstadt

- Sömmerda

Gebäude-Energieberatung 

Die Nachfrage nach Gebäude-Energieberatung steigt stark: Kunden wollen ihre Öl- und Gaskosten senken und Immobilien zukunftssicher sanieren. Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger.

Ideal für Quereinsteiger 

Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung.

Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen 

In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung.

ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint 

Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke.

Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn 

„Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen.

Aufgaben

Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen. 

Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen.

Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben:

- Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern

- Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel

- Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden

- Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten

- Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth

- Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen

- Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office

Qualifikation

Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen: 

- Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten.

- Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen.

- Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen.

- Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs.

- Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern.

- Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren.

Sie benötigen: 

- Technisches Verständnis 

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen

Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater.

Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen.

Benefits

- Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells

- Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt.

- Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden

- Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer

CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern.

Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten.

Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll.

Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht.

Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn."

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. 

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss .

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. 

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us!

Why this role matters

Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand.

That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team .

Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals

How the role sits in the team

You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling.

What you will do

- Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus.

- Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners.

- Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows.

- Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements.

- Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling.

- Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR).

What we are looking for:

- Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking.

- Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus.

- Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike.

- High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved.

- Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany.

- Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German.

- Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin.

Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

What you get

- Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system.

- Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined.

- Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals.

- Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%.

- Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare.

- One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner.

- Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with.

What success looks like

- After 3 months, you know Valova’s stack inside out and have taken a hospital through its first technical setup together with our team.

- After 6 months, you’ve taken at least two hospitals live, and a new KIS connection takes weeks instead of months.

- After 12 months, our deployments are largely repeatable: connectors, scripts and monitoring you built make every go-live faster.

- Throughout, what you learn in hospitals shapes our roadmap, and hospital IT teams see you as their trusted contact at Valova.

How it works

Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps:

- Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions.

- Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into your engineering experience and the integrations you’ve built.

- Case: You work through a realistic hospital integration scenario and present it to the team.

- References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues.

- Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day.

- Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly.

We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.

We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.

#The role 

Think of it as the founders’ office with one clear spine: talent and culture. Two thirds of your time goes there. You drive searches end to end with the founders and help protect the hiring bar, founders included. You build and run our culture programs, feedback cycles and promotion rounds, and you keep our values a working standard that every interview and promotion actually scores against.

The other third is leverage for the founders: the strategic projects that have no department yet. The next planning cycle, an offsite that matters, a build-vs-buy question, the board update. You pick things up whole and put them down finished.

There is a People system in place: leveling, Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser. Keep what works, rebuild what doesn’t. It’s yours to shape.

#What you will do 

- Hiring: Full-cycle recruiting for few, senior, often technical roles. Outbound-first: you map markets and build pipelines from scratch rather than waiting for applications, and you run the culture screen as the first interview of every process.

- Culture: Our ADEPT values as a working rubric. Every interview, feedback cycle and promotion scores against it, and you keep it sharp.

- Development and retention: Leveling, salary bands, a semi-annual feedback cycle, promotion rounds, VSOP administration.

- Founders’ office: Strategic projects end to end, from planning cycles to board preparation.

- Tooling and automation: Our ATS contract ends next year; you help pick and roll out its successor. You build automations across our ATS, Notion and Humaans so manual work keeps shrinking.

#What we offer 

- People decisions at a 40-person company are company decisions, and you make them with the founders

- VSOP participation like everyone here: if the Operating System for Renewables becomes what we are building, that stake is meaningful

- Salary band shared in the first conversation, not after four rounds

- Development: educational leave, a steep curve by design

- Team & culture: regular offsites

- Mobility & health: JobRad, up to 100% Deutschlandticket subsidy, pension plan, Wellpass/Urban Sports, childcare subsidies

Requirements

#What you bring

- Evidence of excellence, wherever you come from: top-tier consulting or VC, a founders associate seat ready for real ownership, an early startup role where you did a bit of everything well, or your own founding attempt. You were among the best there, and you can show it. We will ask for the proof.

- A talent radar with evidence: people you backed, hired or recommended early who turned out exceptional, and at least one call you made against the room that aged well.

- AI as your default way of working, not a tool you tried. You use LLMs daily and can walk us through real workflows you built. In the interview, you will show us one, live.

- Automation literacy: You have connected tools via APIs or no-code (Apps Script, Zapier/Make/n8n or similar) to kill manual work. You read API docs without flinching. You do not need to be an engineer; you need to think like one about repetitive tasks.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Join the battery cell data revolution⚡

Location: Chemnitz (onsite preferred, hybrid possible) · 
Position: Full-time · 
Start: As soon as possible

Who We Are 🌍

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do 🔧

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

• Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production

• Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.

• Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.

• Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.

• Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring 🕵️

• Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.

• Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.

• Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.

• Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.

• Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica 🚀

• Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.

• Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.

• Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.

• Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning

• Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

Apply ✉️

Apply via the Link with your CV and with a few lines on the trickiest measurement artifact you've ever hunted down. That tells us more than any cover letter. Code samples or a GitHub link are welcome, not required.

Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡

title: AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. 

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss .

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. 

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us!

Why this role matters

Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova : the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters .

Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it.

This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build.

How the role sits in the team

You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on the agent pipeline, infrastructure and evaluation. With Malte and our product team, you translate what is technically possible into product decisions. Our doctors and coding experts are your sparring partners for clinical quality, and our forward deployed team brings back how the agents perform in real hospitals.

Du berichtest direkt an Christian, unseren CTO, und arbeitest täglich mit unserem Engineering-Team an der Agenten-Pipeline, der Infrastruktur und der Evaluation. Mit Malte und unserem Produktteam übersetzt Du, was technisch möglich ist, in Produktentscheidungen. Unsere Ärzt:innen und Kodierexpert:innen sind Deine Sparringspartner für klinische Qualität, und unser Forward-Deployed-Team bringt zurück, wie die Agenten in echten Kliniken performen.

What you will do

- Build state-of-the-art agents: You build high-performing agentic systems that define the state of the art in healthcare text processing, while staying efficient in token usage and leveraging small models wherever possible.

- Make every decision traceable: You ensure every decision and output of our agents is traced, and you monitor their performance in production.

- Measure what matters: You build the evaluation and benchmarking setup that tells us, on every change, whether our agents got better or worse.

- Bring research to production: You follow new AI/ML approaches, benchmark promising ideas and make sure the best results reach production within weeks.

- Shape the product: You use your AI/ML expertise to evaluate future projects and inform product decisions.

What we are looking for:

- Production experience: At least two years building and shipping ML/AI systems in production.

- LLM and agent expertise: Strong experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks.

- Engineering depth: Strong proficiency in your primary programming language.

- Evaluation mindset: Experience with observability, evaluation and benchmarking of ML systems.

- Product mindset: You care about outcomes that lead to great user experiences and are passionate about using LLMs in real-world scenarios rather than academic research.

- Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, regulated environments or with sensitive data.

- Languages: You speak fluent English. German is a big plus, since the clinical documents our agents process are in German.

- Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin.

Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

What you get 

- Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system.

- Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined.

- Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals.

- Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%.

- Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare.

- One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner.

- Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with.

What success looks like

- After 3 months, you know our agent pipeline inside out, every agent decision is traced, and you have shipped your first improvement to production.

- After 6 months, our evaluation and benchmarking setup runs on every change, and you have measurably improved coding quality or reduced token costs per case.

- After 12 months, at least one new approach from research is running in production, and parts of our pipeline run on smaller models without losing quality.

- Throughout, our AI-related product decisions are grounded in your benchmarks, and the team turns to you when a new model or method comes out.

How it works

Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps:

- Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions.

- Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into the ML/AI systems you’ve built and how you evaluated them in production.

- Case: You design an agentic approach for a realistic clinical coding problem, including how you would evaluate it, and present it to the team.

- References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues.

- Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day.

- Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly.

We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.

title: Projekt Management Marktkommunikation (d/w/m)

title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

About the Support Group 

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we've invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it's the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations' quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team 

Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:

- 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position

- Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)

- Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis 

- Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R 

- Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets

- Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:

- Experience using ML for forecasting

- Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform

- Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools

What we offer

- The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.

- You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙 

- You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
