title: Senior Treasury Operations Analyst
description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential. 

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

If that excites you, how about joining our Treasury Operations team as a Senior Treasury Operations Analyst? Reporting to the Treasury Operations Lead, you will support Treasury Operations activities across ClearBank Group entities, including cash management, FX settlement, collateral and margin management and related processes. The role is responsible for executing complex operational activity with a high degree of accuracy and control, supporting day‑to‑day Treasury and contributing to the safe, resilient operation of a control‑critical function, while ensuring excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. As a senior member of the team, the role will deputise for the Treasury Operations Lead when required, providing operational leadership on shift, including coaching and direction to team members, while identifying efficiencies and continuous improvements across the function.

Please note - This role operates within a shift‑based Treasury Operations environment. Specific shift arrangements are communicated separately and may vary over time.

Your role includes:

- Execute Treasury Operations activities across multiple ClearBank Group entities and multi‑currency Nostro accounts, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and strong control discipline

- Perform and monitor FX settlement activity with multiple FX providers, resolving issues and exceptions within agreed procedures

- Support cash and liquidity management processes, working closely with Treasury to manage intraday and end‑of‑day balances

- Manage collateral and margin activity relating to UK securities, including transfers, settlement and ongoing monitoring of asset sales

- Ensure all Treasury and cash management instruments, including FX swaps and money market funds, are confirmed and settled without exceptions

- Deputise for the Treasury Operations Shift Manager when required, leading operational activity on shift and acting as a point of escalation within established BAU and contingency procedures

- Exercise sound judgement during live operational issues, escalating in a timely manner where there is a high degree of certainty that existing processes or controls may fail

- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance Treasury Operations processes, controls and workflows

- Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams and, where required, external counterparties to support smooth operational delivery

- Produce operational reporting and management information as required to support oversight and decision‑making

- Support the onboarding and operation of new Treasury instruments and products as ClearBank Group’s offering evolves

What you’ll bring: 

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

- Experience in Treasury Operations, cash management or payments operations within a regulated financial services environment

- Strong working knowledge of FX settlement, Nostro account management and liquidity processes

- Experience managing or supporting collateral and margin activity, including securities settlement

- Proven ability to operate effectively in a time‑critical or shift‑based environment

- Sound understanding of operational risk, controls and escalation frameworks

- Experience producing or contributing to operational reporting and MI

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams and with external parties

Beneficial skills:

- Experience supporting multiple legal entities and currencies

- Exposure to new product or instrument launches within Treasury or Operations

- Knowledge of UK securities settlement processes and market infrastructure

- Experience contributing to process improvement or operational change initiatives

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you? 

- You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

- You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

- You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

- ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

- Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

- Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

- Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

- Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

- Socials – Regular social events open to all.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Hi 👋 I’m Nitesh, Engineering Manager at hyperexponential. I'm one for the career mentors in the Product Foundations stream. We tackle the fundamental problems every product team at hx runs into, so the vertical streams can focus on building features for customers. Right now that means deployments, observability, security, AI observability tooling and a permission service that other value streams will build on.

I’m hiring a Senior Security Engineer to join us as our second security hire. The foundations are already in place. We’ve chosen and implemented our tooling, and our repositories and cloud environments are onboarded. The next step is shaping how security actually works here. This won’t be a traditional, hierarchical security function. Our engineers go straight to the person who owns an issue and ask them to fix it, and you’ll help define what security looks like in that model.

There’s no established playbook for this yet, which is what makes it exciting. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, I’d love to hear from you.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Security function

The Security function's mission is to safeguard the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of our customers' data and hx's systems. By fostering a culture of vigilance, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement, we maintain the highest standards of security excellence.

Security at hx underpins every product and every customer interaction. As we scale our multi-product platform globally and adopt AI across the business, the team ensures that innovation and growth are matched with rigorous security practices. We design controls, shape culture, and guide decisions that protect our business, our customers, and the wider industry.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you’ll be the second engineer in our security team, working directly alongside our Staff Security Engineer. The foundations are in place, with our core tooling chosen, rolled out and onboarded across our repositories and cloud environments. Much of how security works at hx is still to be built, though, so you’ll have real autonomy to shape it, with a direct line to the teams who own the issues you find. You’ll strengthen hx’s security posture by driving continuous improvement across our technical teams: owning security reviews, running and extending our security tooling, and turning findings into fixes, often by writing the code or making the infrastructure change yourself. You’ll champion security initiatives across the organisation, help teams adopt AI securely, and use AI to multiply your own impact. This role combines hands-on technical depth, ownership and influence to make security a practical part of how our teams work every day.

Check out our Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

- Modify, maintain, and extend our security tooling across engineering and IT environments, including CSPM, SAST, SCA, and secret scanning, ensuring it's reliable, well tuned, and genuinely useful to the teams who depend on it.

- Use our tooling and your own judgement to proactively identify gaps across cloud security, dependencies, secrets, and code. Work with the owning teams (starting with 2 to 3 where the gaps are greatest) to secure their commitment to prioritise remediation, and see it through.

- Write code and make infrastructure changes yourself to fix security issues and improve our tooling, rather than just recommending improvements.

- Own security reviews end to end, partnering with engineering teams on new designs, significant changes, and new tools, and working through follow-up questions and challenges until each review is resolved.

- Take ownership of and complete a medium-sized security project within your first three months.

- Partner with our IT team on security best practice, helping implement practical improvements in authentication, authorisation, and security hygiene across our corporate environment.

- Guide teams across the business on adopting AI securely, from assessing new AI tools and use cases to mitigating risks like data leakage and prompt injection, while using AI yourself to increase your impact.

- Support our compliance programmes, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, by helping teams implement and evidence technical controls.

- Act as a trusted voice for our technical teams, owning security issues raised with them through to resolution and handling the related correspondence.

What you'll need to have done

- Secured AWS cloud environments hands-on: using Cloud Security tooling to find common weaknesses, and fixing them yourself through infrastructure and code changes. Cloud Security experience is required.

- Secured containerised workloads and infrastructure-as-code, catching issues before they reach production.

- Experience working with SAST, SCA, and secret scanning tools, including triaging findings, filtering out false positives, and partnering with engineering teams to get real fixes shipped

- Supported compliance efforts such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or GDPR by implementing and evidencing technical controls.

- Used AI to improve your own security work and helped others adopt it safely, with a practical understanding of AI-specific risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, and agents and integrations with excessive permissions.

- Spotted and addressed non-technical risks, such as weak processes, risky behaviours, and gaps between teams, that can undermine technical security.

- Discussed security in depth with engineering teams, explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely and influencing teams through to implementation.

- Taken ownership of security projects and initiatives and driven them to completion independently.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

- You prefer to advise from the sidelines rather than writing code and making the infrastructure changes yourself.

- You see security as a gatekeeping function rather than a service to the teams you support, whose adoption and trust determine your success.

- You'd rather wait for direction than take ownership of issues, follow them through to resolution, and manage the correspondence around them.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

- £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

- 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

- Company pension scheme via Penfold.

- Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .

- Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

- Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

- Income protection and Life Insurance.

- Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

- Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

- Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

- Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

- Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

- Talent Interview (30 minutes)

- Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

- Skills Assessment (120 minutes)

- Values Interview (60 minutes)

- Meet the CEO (30 minutes)

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Research Engineer (Materials Foundation Models)
description:
About CuspAI 

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. 

The Role

To scale our scientific intelligence and data curation capabilities, we are looking for three Research Engineers * to train and evaluate the foundation models behind our materials discovery platform: representation learning over crystal structures and properties, LLM fine-tuning and post-training for scientific tasks, and the evaluation and data work that makes those models useful. You will work in a small team where each person owns a model end to end, from data and experiment design through training at scale to integration.

*Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role. 

Your Impact

You will be responsible for building and training specialised foundation models on terabytes of scientific data at massive scale , fundamentally enhancing our platform's multi-modal capabilities .

The modalities span crystal structures, properties, text and images. Depending on your background you may lead on self-supervised representation learning, LLM fine-tuning and post-training (SFT, RL), or the evaluation suites that decide between them.

What You Will Do

Research and Model Training at Scale 

- Design and run experiments : scaling studies, ablations and evaluations that settle which modelling choices survive.

- Lead efforts in parallel training of multi-modal foundation models at scale (e.g. orchestrating parallel training across hundreds of GPUs and handling data in the order of Terabytes).

- Apply strong software engineering best practices to ensure the systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

- Own the data curation and evaluation design for your models; these outlast the modelling decisions.

Scientific Collaboration & Integration 

- Partner closely with our Chemists and Materials Scientists to integrate computational and experimental workflows into one seamless optimisation loop.

- Be proactive in learning the technical vocabulary of materials science and experimental chemistry to facilitate meaningful interactions with domain experts.

- Contribute to our mission by ensuring all system designs align with CuspAI's commitment to sustainability and world-changing challenges.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

- You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain, with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that CuspAI is building.

- Strong software engineering skills and a proven track record of building complex, high-performance systems at scale in a production or industrial environment.

- Hands-on experience training or evaluating large models in a distributed setting. For senior candidates this means having led a multi-hundred-GPU training effort; for earlier-career candidates, having been a core contributor to one.

API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling.

Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth.

Experience with cloud providers.

Hands-on experience with cloud providers, preferably GCP, and working with audit and logging data.

Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI).

Product Security (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

- Be proficient in securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that security best practices are applied consistently across our cloud environment

- Be proficient in threat modelling and guide developers in secure design principles to prevent vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place

- Help remediate vulnerabilities through strategic initiatives, writing patches, or creating understandable and actionable vulnerability tickets.

- Be the subject matter expert across a wide range of security areas, particularly in Application Security.

- Make security invisible when possible, believing that gatekeeping and blocking product teams should be avoided in favour of enabling secure development.

- Mentor and coach junior engineers, sharing your knowledge to help raise the security bar across the organisation

- Leverage automation and security tools to seamlessly integrate security into our CI/CD pipelines, ensuring vulnerabilities are caught early without disrupting development.

- You have excellent spoken and written communication skills to articulate vulnerabilities clearly and persuasively, advocating for their remediation even when faced with competing production pressures.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.

Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.

This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.

You will report to Basil Lizotte , and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops & Risk, Product and Tech.

💼 About the job

As Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.

You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.

Build reliable data foundations for Revenue

- Build and evolve business-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.

- Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end-to-end data pipelines.

Turn business questions into strategic insights

- Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.

- Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.

Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth

- Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.

- Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.

Drive data excellence across Revenue

- Promote data-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.

- Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.

🧰 You will work with

SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

- You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue-related information, including Salesforce data.

- You have experience building business-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.

- You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.

- You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing technology or fintech environment.

And it will be nice if you also

- You have experience with Looker and LookML.

- You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.

- You have worked with tracking tools such as Rudderstack or Segment, as well as experimentation methodologies such as A/B testing, significance testing and causal analysis.

- You are curious about AI-assisted tools and are interested in using tools such as Claude Code in your daily workflow.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 Your Alma experience

The culture

At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.

You will have access to our Learning & Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.

We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.

The role itself

If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:

- Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.

- Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.

- Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap 

- Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

- Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

- Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

- Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell 

- Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

- Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

- Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners 

- Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

- Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

- Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

- Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

- PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

- 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap 

- Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

- You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

- You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

- You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

- Fluent in English 

Nice to have

- You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

- Scientific authorship : Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

- Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

- Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge : ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

- Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

- Templated reporting : report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

- Mission: work on the forefront of cancer research.

- Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

- Impact: pharma teams make real portfolio decisions with what you define.

- Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

title: Equipment Engineer - Automation
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Missions and activities of the position 

1. Project phase – owner's engineer for Maintenance 

- Represent Maintenance in every phase of new equipment projects (starting with the MRS1 cross-belt sorter), from design reviews to FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up. For the sorter, whose design is already set, take over the installed system and optimise it after go-live.

- Work side by side with the OEM / integrator engineers: collect technical knowledge, challenge design choices, maintainability, access, spare-part strategy and the proposed maintenance plan before they are frozen.

- Define and verify the Maintenance acceptance criteria (documentation, training, spare parts, safety, availability targets). The Maintenance sign-off is mandatory: no handover to operations without it.

- Track and drive to closure the technical punch list and warranty issues raised during commissioning and the warranty period.

2. Technical file & spare parts 

- Build and own the equipment technical file: as-built electrical and mechanical drawings, PLC and software versions, parameter backups, network architecture, safety documentation, OEM manuals.

- Create the asset hierarchy and criticality analysis in the CMMS.

- Define the critical spare-parts list (references, min/max stock, lead times) and keep it up to date.

- Reduce dependency on the OEM: identify and qualify second-source suppliers for critical parts, run compatibility tests and document equivalences.

- Propose spare-parts and supplier decisions to the Maintenance Manager; after an initial period, take these decisions autonomously within agreed limits, with the Maintenance Manager's validation.

3. Maintenance strategy & procedures 

- Write and maintain preventive maintenance plans, corrective procedures and troubleshooting guides for the equipment family, based on OEM data, FMEA and field experience.

- Monitor equipment performance (availability, MTBF, MTTR, top failure modes), lead root-cause analysis on recurring or major failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

- Challenge the original design when needed and drive engineering changes: retrofits, drive and firmware updates, software or parameter optimisation, with the OEM and internal stakeholders.

4. Training & technical support 

- Train the operational maintenance team (technicians and operatives) on the equipment, its software/HMI and the troubleshooting procedures; validate their autonomy level.

- Act as the level-2 / level-3 technical expert for the equipment family on site and remotely, across sites.

5. Escalation, vendor & SLA management 

- Own technical escalations through to resolution: with the Tetris team (Vinted's internal tools and sorting logic) when the issue is on the software or data side, and with OEM / integrator support (SAV) when it is on the equipment side.

- Lead the diagnosis that tells which side an issue comes from (equipment, controls, Vinted software), with facts and data.

- Work within the after-sales and maintenance agreements already in place with OEMs: make the most of them day to day, monitor performance against SLAs and warranty terms, feed lessons learned into future renewals, and provide the technical evidence to the program managers, who own the contractual relationship.

- Prepare and lead technical review meetings with OEMs and integrators.

6. Safety & compliance 

- Ensure the equipment and its maintenance comply with machine safety requirements (CE marking, safety functions, lock-out/tag-out) and site H&S standards.

- Support safety audits and regulatory inspections, and drive the resulting corrective actions to completion.

Occasional responsibilities 

- Take ownership of additional equipment families (e.g. conveyors, AMR fleets, Monk lines) once the cross-belt is stable.

- Support pre-project technical due diligence on new equipment (specifications, vendor benchmarks, maintainability review).

- Participate in the hiring and onboarding of maintenance technicians and future engineers.

Interests, constraints, difficulties of the position 

- High-visibility role on new strategic automation investments.

- Site-based in an operational warehouse, with regular presence on the shop floor.

- Regular travel to MRS1, OEM premises (FAT) and other Vinted Go sites, especially during commissioning.

- Day-based role, no on-call. Flexibility needed during commissioning, ramp-up and major incidents (possible early, late or weekend work).

- Needs to influence without authority: OEMs, integrators, IT and program management teams.

Your profile 

Knowledge & experience 

- Engineering degree (Master's / Bac+5) in automation, electrical, mechatronics or industrial engineering, or Bac+2/3 with equivalent proven experience.

- At least 3 years' experience, ideally 5 or more, as Equipment Engineer, Automation Engineer, Tool Owner or Maintenance/Reliability Engineer in a highly automated environment: parcel sortation and intralogistics, airport baggage handling, logistics or other automated industries.

- Automation background required.

- Proven involvement in at least one industrial equipment project from FAT/SAT to ramp-up, working with OEMs or integrators.

Technical skills 

- Able to read and diagnose complete PLC and HMI programs (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell, Beckhoff) and to make controlled modifications; industrial networks (Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP).

- Drives (parameters, firmware), servo motors, sensors, scanners / DWS, pneumatics; reading electrical and mechanical schematics.

- Retrofit experience and component qualification (equivalence, compatibility testing)

- Safety PLCs and machine safety functions.

- Understanding of the interfaces between equipment controls, SCADA/WCS and IT systems.

- Reliability methods: FMEA, RCA (5 Why, Ishikawa, 8D), criticality analysis; CMMS and PM planning.

- Sortation equipment experience (cross-belt, tilt-tray, shoe sorters) is a strong plus.

- French electrical certification (habilitation électrique BR / B2V / BC) or ability to obtain it.

- Fluent French and professional English (OEMs and the Vinted Go network work in English).

Behavioural skills 

- Strong ownership: treats the equipment as their own, from design to end of life.

- Able to challenge OEM and integrator engineers constructively, with facts and data.

- Structured and disciplined in documentation.

- Good teacher: enjoys transferring knowledge to technicians.

- Calm and solution-oriented under production pressure; strong safety mindset.

Please note: the main tasks and skills identified and noted in the function described above may need to evolve depending on the constraints and organisation specific to the company and its environment. They are, therefore, indicative and not contractual. 

Working at Vinted 

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€45.000 — €60.000 EUR

title: Devops Engineer
description:
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users. 

You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices.

You will have the opportunity to: 

- Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities. 

- Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation. 

- Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together. 

Within 1 month, you will 

- Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture.

- Become familiar with our R&D way of working.

- Understand the team’s processes.

Within 3 months, you will 

- Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible and Helm.

- Automate the deployment of applications, configurations and infrastructure to achieve a high level of flexibility and confidence in production setups and deployment processes.

- Improve our global security, challenge our worldwide scaling, increase our performance.

Within 6 months, you will: 

- Collaborate with other squads to implement and improve our DevOps practices.

- Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to improve system stability and availability.

- Manage and maintain our Azure cloud infrastructure.

- Ensure the security and compliance of our systems and data.

- Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support.

- Manage incidents and post-mortem.

- Work closely with developers to facilitate their daily tasks, help them conform to best practices and ensure environments meet requirements (e.g.: simplify and automate the deployment process, provide metrics and monitoring to the engineering squads).

- Build and improve our internal platform: easy-to-deploy tools and templates that move infrastructure work off the squads' plate ("shift down"), so developers can ship without being infrastructure experts.

- Improve monitoring and load testing to secure and enhance the performance of our infrastructure

Within 12 months, you will: 

- Actively participate in DevOps decisions for all critical projects related to our platform’s performance and reliability.

- Evangelize and train our R&D team on Devops culture by defining all best practices and building them into the platform by default.

The Skill Set 

- 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.

- Ideally, you have worked in a tech or a SaaS company

- You know how to run systems in production

- Interest in platform engineering and developer experience: you like building tools that other engineers enjoy using

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, GitOps).

- Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration.

- You have a coding background (scripting, programming)

- Passion for automation and continuous improvement.

- You have working proficiency in English (level B2 or equivalent)Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)

- Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L 

Our technical stack 

- 
Cloud: Azure Cloud

- 
Container orchestration: k8s, ArgoCD

- 
Infra as Code: Terraform, AnsibleHelm

- 
Monitoring tool: Datadog

- 
Database: MongoDB Atlas

- 
Application language: Javascript

What we offer: 

- Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

- Benefits/Perks : Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 

- Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion : We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

- Corporate Social Responsibility : Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍

- Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

- 
Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

- 
Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

- 
Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

- 
Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

- 
Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

- 
Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

- 
Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

- 
Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

- 
Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

- 
Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

- 
La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

- 
Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

- 
La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

- 
Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

- 
La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

- 
Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

- 
Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

- 
Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

- 
Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

- 
Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

- 
Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

- 
Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

- 
Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Builder
description:

TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE :

L'équipe Product & Engineering, c'est le cerveau technologique de Seyna : elle construit la plateforme qui fait tourner Seyna et ses courtiers, du travail de discovery jusqu'à la mise en production, en sprints de 2 semaines. En tant que Software Product Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Tech avec un rôle unique, embarqué au plus près des équipes métier (actuariat, juridique, comptabilité…), en reportant directement à Guillaume, notre CPTO. Ta mission : construire avec l'IA les outils qui vont démultiplier la productivité de toute l'entreprise !

CE QUE TU FERAS :

- Immersion métier : Plonger dans l'équipe que tu outilles et pratiquer réellement son métier, pour comprendre de l'intérieur ses processus, ses contraintes réglementaires et ses irritants du quotidien.

- Discovery & priorisation : Mener la recherche utilisateur (interviews, observation, analyse des process), identifier les problèmes à plus fort impact et piloter seul ton backlog selon la valeur business attendue.

- Specs & architecture : Traduire les besoins en specs concises et en décisions d'architecture documentées, pour que chaque choix soit tracé et facilement repris par l'équipe Tech.

- Delivery de bout en bout : Développer, tester et mettre en production toi-même tes solutions, avec un vrai niveau de qualité production (code review, tests, monitoring, documentation). Livrer vite, sans créer de dette !

- L'IA au cœur du build : Utiliser les agents de code (Claude Code…) comme levier de vélocité, et intégrer l'IA directement dans les outils que tu construis : automatisation, extraction, génération, agents métier.

- Mesure & itération : Définir des critères de succès avec le métier, mesurer l'adoption et l'impact de tes outils, et itérer rapidement à partir des données et des retours utilisateurs.

- Alignement & diffusion : Réutiliser les briques existantes de la plateforme Seyna avec les équipes Product & Engineering, faire remonter ce qui mérite d'être industrialisé et partager tes méthodes de build augmenté par l'IA pour faire monter toute l'organisation en niveau.

TU ES AU BON ENDROIT SI :

- Tu maîtrises le développement full-stack en TypeScript (React, Node.js) sur AWS et GitHub, et tu livres du code de qualité production.

- Tu as une vraie rigueur d'ingénierie : architecture réfléchie, tests, code review, monitoring et documentation font partie de ton ADN.

- Tu es AI-native : les agents de code font partie de ton quotidien, et tu sais intégrer l'IA dans des produits utiles.

- Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code.

- Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien.

- Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite.

- Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique.

- ✨ Bonus si tu as déjà rédigé des specs et arbitré un backlog dans un rôle de Product Manager.

CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE :

💵 Rémunération : Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que vous puissiez partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons.

🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés.

🍜 Ticket restaurant : Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60% par Seyna (10€/jour).

🚇 Transport en commun : 50% de votre moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna.

🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95% par Seyna

🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble.

🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) !

NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT :

En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 2 à 3 semaines ! Voici plus de détail ci-dessous :

- Un 1er échange avec Gianni (Talent Acquisition Manager) - 45' → Tu pourras mieux comprendre le rôle, les missions et ce qu'on attend pour ce poste.

- Un Hiring Manager Interview avec Guillaume (CPTO) - 45' → Cela te permettra d'entrer dans le détail du poste : les missions au quotidien, les défis et les attentes liées au rôle.

- Un Skills-based Assessment avec Kseniia (Engineering Manager) et Maxime (Senior Staff Engineer) - 60' → Le case te donne l'occasion de montrer concrètement tes compétences et ton savoir-faire en lien avec le job.

- Un Seynalma Interview avec Charlotte (Client Performance Director) et Anne-Céline (Senior CSM) - 2x45' → Cela te permettra de voir si notre culture d'entreprise colle avec tes valeurs et ta façon de travailler.

- Un Final Interview avec Stephen (CEO) - 30' → C'est le moment d'échanger avec notre CEO et de voir si tes drivers matchent avec nos 3 Unique Selling Propositions pour les Talents !

Compensation: €75K – €90K • Offers Equity

title: Sales Development Representative - CDI
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Notre mission 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. 

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! 

Le mot de la CEO 

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

Et ce poste alors ? 

Le rôle 

En première ligne de notre développement commercial , tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court.

Missions et responsabilités 

- Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire. Tu contacteras les prospects via une approche multicanale avec une majorité de Cold Calling (notre cible d'artisans est très réceptive au téléphone), du Cold Emailing et LinkedIn.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO 

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT 

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

- Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

- Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

- Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE 

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

- You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

- You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE 

- Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Senior Structural Assembly Manufacturing Engineer
description:
About Electra 

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027. 

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another. 

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways. 

The Role 

As Electra's Senior Structural Assembly Manufacturing Engineer, you'll play a key role in developing and industrializing the structural assembly processes for the EL9 aircraft, working from early product development through prototype build, production implementation, and ramp-up.

You'll work closely with Product Engineering during aircraft development to ensure structural designs incorporate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles and can be efficiently, repeatably, and reliably produced. You'll bring a hands-on manufacturing perspective to structural design decisions, evaluating assembly sequence, tolerance management, access, tooling, fastening and joining methods, inspection requirements, producibility, and production risk.

As the EL9 transitions from design into physical hardware, you'll help translate released engineering into executable manufacturing processes and support prototype and initial aircraft builds. You'll work closely with airframe manufacturing suppliers, providing on-site Manufacturing Engineering oversight and liaison support as needed to ensure proper information flow, resolve technical and quality issues, support the incorporation of product changes and support supply chain on contract management.

This is an opportunity to influence both how the aircraft is designed and how it is ultimately built, while helping establish Electra's structural assembly manufacturing supply chain capability from the ground up.

What You'll Do 

- Partner with Product Engineering throughout aircraft development to ensure structural designs incorporate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles and support efficient, repeatable, and scalable production.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

- Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

- Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

- Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

- Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

Requirements

- Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

- Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

Bonus points

- Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

- Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location

description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. About BridgeBio Pharma, Inc. 

BridgeBio is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering transformative medicines for patients living with genetic diseases and genetically defined cancers. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide. 

Who We Are 

BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we’ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries — with experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company’s international growth. 

At BridgeBio, you’ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. This role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders across multiple countries to ensure high-quality execution and impact. - Strong knowledge of international healthcare systems, pricing and reimbursement frameworks, and regulatory environments.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Storage
description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. - Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings. 

- Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning. 

- Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs. 

- Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do.

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do 

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

Requirements

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

De zorg in Nederland staat onder druk. Er zijn steeds meer mensen die zorg nodig hebben, terwijl het aantal beschikbare zorgprofessionals achterblijft. Over Alii 

Alii is onderdeel van IG&H en richt zich op AI-gedreven beslisondersteuning in de zorg. Het platform helpt zorgprofessionals om medische kennis sneller en makkelijker toe te passen in de praktijk.
